title.zh: 卷二 本紀第二 武帝中
title.raw: 卷二 本紀第二 武帝中 Volume 2: Emperor Wu 2

sentences.zh: 梁書卷第二 本紀第二

translations.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 2, Basic Annals 2
translations.idiomatic: Book of Liang, Volume 2, Annals 2

sentences.zh: 武帝中

translations.literal: Emperor Wu, Part 2
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu, Middle Period

sentences.zh: 天監元年夏四月丙寅，高祖卽皇帝位於南郊。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, day bingyin, summer of the first year of Tianjian, Gaozu assumed the imperial throne at the Southern Suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the fourth month of Tianjian 1 (502 CE), Gaozu took the throne at the Southern Suburbs.

sentences.zh: 設壇柴燎，告類于天曰：「皇帝臣衍，敢用玄牡，昭告于皇天后帝：齊氏以曆運斯旣，否終則亨，欽若天應，以命于衍。

translations.literal: They set up an altar and burnt sacrificial wood, announcing to Heaven: "The Emperor, your servant Yan, dares to use a black bullock to declare clearly to August Heaven and August Lord: The Qi dynasty's allotted span has ended; when obstruction ends, prosperity follows; reverently following Heaven's response, the mandate is conferred upon Yan.
translations.idiomatic: An altar was raised and sacrificial wood burned as he announced to Heaven, "Your servant Yan, Emperor, dares with a black bullock to declare to August Heaven: Qi's allotted time is spent; obstruction has given way to prosperity; following Heaven's sign, the mandate falls to Yan.

sentences.zh: 夫任是司牧，惟能是授；

translations.literal: In appointing those who govern the people, only the capable are granted office;
translations.idiomatic: To govern the people, office goes only to the capable;

sentences.zh: 天命不于常，帝王非一族。

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate is not fixed, and emperors and kings are not confined to one lineage.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate is not constant, and rulers need not come from one clan.

sentences.zh: 唐謝虞受，漢替魏升，爰及晉、宋，憲章在昔。

translations.literal: Tang yielded to Yu's acceptance, Han replaced Wei and rose, extending to Jin and Song—the pattern is set in antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Tang gave way to Yu, Han rose in Wei's place, and Jin and Song followed—the precedent runs deep.

sentences.zh: 咸以君德馭四海，元功子萬姓，故能大庇氓黎，光宅區宇。

translations.literal: All governed the four seas with sovereign virtue, owed their founding achievement to the myriad people, and thus could greatly shelter the common folk and gloriously possess the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Each ruled the realm by virtue, owed his founding to the people, sheltered the masses, and held the land in glory.

sentences.zh: 齊代云季，世主昏凶，狡焉羣慝，是崇是長，肆厥姦回暴亂，以播虐于我有邦，俾溥天惴惴，將墜于深壑。

translations.literal: The Qi age reached its twilight; the ruling lord was benighted and cruel; cunning evil men were exalted and indulged, spreading their treachery and violent disorder to afflict our state, making all under Heaven tremble as if about to plunge into a deep abyss.
translations.idiomatic: Qi entered its decline under a benighted, cruel ruler who exalted wicked men; treachery and violence spread through the realm until all under Heaven seemed ready to fall into an abyss.

sentences.zh: 九服八荒之內，連率岳牧之君，蹶角頓顙，匡救無術，臥薪待然，援天靡訴。

translations.literal: Within the nine domains and eight wilds, regional governors and frontier lords kowtowed with foreheads to earth, found no means of rescue, slept on firewood awaiting the fire, and had no way to appeal to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Across the realm, governors and frontier lords bowed low, could find no remedy, lay on kindling waiting for the blaze, and had no recourse to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 衍投袂星言，摧鋒萬里，厲其掛冠之情，用拯兆民之切。

translations.literal: Yan threw up his sleeves and set forth at star-rise, driving his spear-points ten thousand li, steeling his resolve to resign office, to deliver the people from their urgent distress.
translations.idiomatic: Yan flung up his sleeves and marched at once, driving his spears ten thousand li, hardened in his resolve to lay down office and save the people from urgent peril.

sentences.zh: 銜膽誓衆，覆銳屠堅，建立人主，克翦昏亂。

translations.literal: Biting gall he swore the multitude, overturned sharp blades and slaughtered the stubborn, established a rightful sovereign, and cut down benighted disorder.
translations.idiomatic: He swore the host with gall between his teeth, broke sharp ranks and cut down the hard, raised a rightful ruler, and swept away benighted chaos.

sentences.zh: 遂因時來，宰司邦國，濟民康世，實有厥勞。

translations.literal: He then seized the moment to govern the state, brought ease to the people and peace to the age, and truly earned his merit.
translations.idiomatic: Seizing the moment, he governed the realm, brought ease to the people and peace to the age, and truly earned his merit.

sentences.zh: 而晷緯呈祥，川岳效祉，朝夕坰牧，日月郊畿。

translations.literal: Solar and stellar omens appeared auspicious, rivers and mountains yielded blessings, morning and evening came reports from the frontier pastures, day and night from the capital suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly signs turned auspicious, rivers and mountains sent blessings, and reports flowed morning and evening from the frontiers and the capital.

sentences.zh: 代終之符旣顯，革運之期已萃，殊俗百蠻，重譯獻款，人神遠邇，罔不和會。

translations.literal: The signs of dynastic change were manifest, the time for transformation had gathered; foreign customs and the hundred barbarians sent tribute through repeated translation; men and spirits near and far all joined in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: The omens of dynastic change were clear, the hour of revolution had come, distant peoples sent tribute through many translators, and men and spirits near and far all joined in accord.

sentences.zh: 於是羣公卿士，咸致厥誠，並以皇乾降命，難以謙拒。

translations.literal: Thereupon the assembled lords, ministers, and officials all offered their sincerity, saying that August Heaven had lowered its mandate—humility could not refuse it.
translations.idiomatic: Then lords, ministers, and officials all pledged their loyalty, saying Heaven had lowered the mandate and modest refusal was impossible.

sentences.zh: 齊帝脫屣萬邦，授以神器。

translations.literal: The Qi emperor cast off his realm like casting off worn shoes and handed over the sacred regalia.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi emperor cast off the realm like worn shoes and surrendered the imperial regalia.

sentences.zh: 衍自惟匪德，辭不獲許。

translations.literal: Yan reflected on his lack of virtue but his refusal was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Yan judged himself unworthy, but his refusal was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 仰迫上玄之眷，俯惟億兆之心，宸極不可久曠，民神不可乏主，遂藉樂推，膺此嘉祚。

translations.literal: Pressed from above by Heaven's favor, considering below the hearts of the hundred millions—the throne could not long stand empty, the people and spirits could not lack a lord—he therefore accepted this blessed fortune through the people's willing acclaim.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven pressed from above, the people pressed from below; the throne could not stand empty, the realm could not lack a ruler—so he accepted the mandate through the people's willing acclaim.

sentences.zh: 以茲寡薄，臨御萬方，顧求夙志，永言祗惕。

translations.literal: With such scant virtue he ascended to rule the ten thousand directions, looking back to his long-held aims, ever speaking with reverent caution.
translations.idiomatic: With scant virtue he took the throne over all lands, mindful of his old resolve, ever reverent and cautious.

sentences.zh: 敬簡元辰，恭茲大禮，升壇受禪，告類上帝，克播休祉，以弘盛烈，式傳厥後，用永保于我有梁。

translations.literal: Respectfully selecting the auspicious day, reverently performing this great rite, ascending the altar to receive abdication, announcing to the Supreme Lord, he might spread blessings, magnify the glorious achievement, transmit it to posterity, and forever preserve our Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On the chosen day he performed the great rite, ascended the altar to receive abdication, and announced to Heaven his hope to spread blessing, magnify the achievement, pass it to posterity, and forever preserve Liang.

sentences.zh: 惟明靈是饗。」

translations.literal: May the bright spirits partake of this offering."
translations.idiomatic: May the bright spirits accept this offering."

sentences.zh: 禮畢，備法駕卽建康宮，臨太極前殿。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, with full imperial equipage he entered Jiankang Palace and took his seat at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites ended, he entered Jiankang Palace with full imperial escort and took his seat in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「五精遞襲，皇王所以受命；

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Five Essences succeed one another—this is how emperors and kings receive the mandate;
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The Five Essences pass in turn—that is how emperors and kings receive the mandate;

sentences.zh: 四海樂推，殷、周所以改物。

translations.literal: When the four seas gladly acclaim one—such was how Yin and Zhou changed the regime.
translations.idiomatic: when the four seas gladly acclaim one—that is how Yin and Zhou changed the throne.

sentences.zh: 雖禪代相舛，遭會異時，而微明迭用，其流遠矣。

translations.literal: Though abdication and replacement differ and the times of encounter vary, the faint and bright alternating in use—the current runs far back.
translations.idiomatic: Though abdication and succession differ and times change, the pattern of light and shadow alternating runs far back.

sentences.zh: 莫不振民育德，光被黎元。

translations.literal: None failed to revive the people and nourish virtue, spreading their light over the common folk.
translations.idiomatic: None failed to revive the people, nurture virtue, and spread their light over the common folk.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡闇，命不先後，寧濟之功，屬當期運，乘此時來，因心萬物，遂振厥弛維，大造區夏，永言前蹤，義均慙德。

translations.literal: I am obscure and dim; my mandate did not come early; the work of settling the realm falls to this present fortune; seizing this moment, conforming my heart to the ten thousand things, I restored the slackened bonds, greatly remade the Central Xia—forever speaking of the paths of old, in righteousness I am equally shamed by virtue.
translations.idiomatic: I am obscure and untested; the work of settling the realm falls to this hour; seizing the moment, I restored slackened bonds and remade the Central Xia—yet beside the paths of old I feel my virtue wanting.

sentences.zh: 齊氏以代終有𧗲，歷數云改，欽若前載，集大命于朕躬。

translations.literal: The Qi clan's dynastic term had its end and limit; the reckoning of fate was said to change; reverently following former records, the great mandate gathered upon my person.
translations.idiomatic: Qi's allotted span had reached its limit, the reckoning of fate had turned, and reverently following precedent the great mandate gathered on me.

sentences.zh: 顧惟菲德，辭不獲命，寅畏上靈，用膺景業。

translations.literal: Reflecting on my slight virtue, my refusal did not win consent; with deep reverence for the Supreme Spirit, I accepted the bright enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing my slight virtue, I could not refuse; in awe of Heaven I accepted the bright enterprise.

sentences.zh: 執禋柴之禮，當與能之祚，繼迹百王，君臨四海，若涉大川，罔知攸濟。

translations.literal: Performing the rites of burnt offerings, matching the fortune of the capable, following in the tracks of the hundred kings, ruling the four seas—I am as one crossing a great river, not knowing where to ford.
translations.idiomatic: Having performed the burnt-offering rites and taken up the throne of the capable, I follow the hundred kings and rule the four seas like a man crossing a great river without knowing where to land.

sentences.zh: 洪基初兆，萬品權輿，思俾慶澤，覃被率土。

translations.literal: The great foundation is newly begun, the myriad things are in their first rising; I think to let blessed favor spread and drench all within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The great foundation is newly laid and the myriad things just rising; I wish to spread blessing through the whole realm.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty for the empire may be granted.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty is granted for the empire.

sentences.zh: 改齊中興二年爲天監元年。

translations.literal: Change Qi Zhongxing year 2 to Tianjian year 1.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Zhongxing 2 is changed to Tianjian 1.

sentences.zh: 賜民爵二級；

translations.literal: Bestow two ranks of nobility upon the people;
translations.idiomatic: The people are granted two ranks of nobility;

sentences.zh: 文武加位二等；

translations.literal: Advance civil and military officials two ranks;
translations.idiomatic: civil and military officials are advanced two ranks;

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人穀五斛。

translations.literal: To widowers, widows, orphans, and solitaries unable to support themselves, five hu of grain per person.
translations.idiomatic: widowers, widows, orphans, and the destitute receive five hu of grain each.

sentences.zh: 逋布、口錢、宿債勿復收。

translations.literal: Arrears in cloth levies, head taxes, and old debts shall no longer be collected.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears in cloth levies, head taxes, and old debts are forgiven.

sentences.zh: 其犯鄉論清議，贓汙淫盜，一皆蕩滌，洗除前注，與之更始。」

translations.literal: Those guilty under local moral verdicts—corruption, debauchery, theft—shall all be wiped clean, previous records erased, and given a fresh start."
translations.idiomatic: Those condemned for corruption, debauchery, or theft under local moral verdicts are pardoned, their records erased, and given a fresh start."

sentences.zh: 封齊帝爲巴陵王，全食一郡。

translations.literal: Enfeoff the Qi emperor as Prince of Baling, with full revenue of one commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi emperor is enfeoffed as Prince of Baling with the full revenue of one commandery.

sentences.zh: 載天子旌旗，乘五時副車。

translations.literal: Bearing the imperial banner and riding in the five-seasons escort chariots.
translations.idiomatic: He bears the imperial banner and rides in the five-season escort chariots.

sentences.zh: 行齊正朔。

translations.literal: Follow Qi's calendar.
translations.idiomatic: He follows Qi's calendar.

sentences.zh: 郊祀天地，禮樂制度，皆用齊典。

translations.literal: Sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, ritual, music, and institutions—all use Qi precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, ritual, music, and institutions all follow Qi precedent.

sentences.zh: 齊宣德皇后爲齊文帝妃，齊后王氏爲巴陵王妃。

translations.literal: Qi Empress Xuande was made consort to Qi Emperor Wen; Qi Empress Wang was made Princess of Baling.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Empress Xuande became consort to Qi Emperor Wen, and Qi Empress Wang became Princess of Baling.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「興運升降，前代舊章。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The rise and fall of fortune—former dynasties had their old rules.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The rise and fall of fortune was governed by old rules in former dynasties.

sentences.zh: 齊世王侯封爵，悉皆降省。

translations.literal: Qi-era princes and marquises and their enfeoffments shall all be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Qi-era princes, marquises, and their enfeoffments are all reduced.

sentences.zh: 其有效著艱難者，別有後命。

translations.literal: Those whose merit in hardship was outstanding shall receive separate later orders.
translations.idiomatic: Those who showed outstanding merit in hardship will receive separate orders later.

sentences.zh: 惟宋汝陰王不在除例。

translations.literal: Only the Song Prince of Ruyin is excluded from this reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Song Prince of Ruyin is exempt from this reduction.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「大運肇升，嘉慶惟始，劫賊餘口沒在臺府者，悉可蠲放。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "As the great fortune newly rises and auspicious celebration begins, remnant captives from banditry held in government offices may all be released.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said, "As the new fortune rises and celebration begins, captives taken from bandits and held in government offices may all be released.

sentences.zh: 諸流徙之家，並聽還本。」

translations.literal: All households subjected to exile shall be permitted to return home."
translations.idiomatic: All exiled households are permitted to return home."

sentences.zh: 追尊皇考爲文皇帝，廟曰太祖；

translations.literal: Posthumously honor the Late Emperor's father as Emperor Wen, temple name Taizu;
translations.idiomatic: The Late Emperor's father is posthumously honored as Emperor Wen, temple name Taizu;

sentences.zh: 皇妣爲獻皇后。

translations.literal: The Late Emperor's mother as Empress Xian.
translations.idiomatic: and his mother as Empress Xian.

sentences.zh: 追諡妃郗氏爲德皇后。

translations.literal: Posthumously give the consort Lady Chi the title Empress De.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Lady Chi is posthumously titled Empress De.

sentences.zh: 追封兄太傅懿爲長沙郡王，諡曰宣武；

translations.literal: Posthumously enfeoff elder brother Yi, Grand Tutor, as Prince of Changsha, posthumous title Xuanwu;
translations.idiomatic: Elder brother Yi, Grand Tutor, is posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Changsha with posthumous title Xuanwu;

sentences.zh: 齊後軍諮議敷爲永陽郡王，諡曰昭；

translations.literal: Qi Rear Army Advisory Aide Fu as Prince of Yongyang, posthumous title Zhao;
translations.idiomatic: Qi Rear Army Advisory Aide Fu as Prince of Yongyang, posthumous title Zhao;

sentences.zh: 弟齊太常暢爲衡陽郡王，諡曰宣；

translations.literal: Younger brother Qi Grand Master of Ceremonies Chang as Prince of Hengyang, posthumous title Xuan;
translations.idiomatic: younger brother Qi Grand Master of Ceremonies Chang as Prince of Hengyang, posthumous title Xuan;

sentences.zh: 齊給事黃門侍郎融爲桂陽郡王，諡曰簡。

translations.literal: Qi Bearer of the Yellow Gate Rong as Prince of Guiyang, posthumous title Jian.
translations.idiomatic: and Qi Bearer of the Yellow Gate Rong as Prince of Guiyang, posthumous title Jian.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔封文武功臣新除車騎將軍夏侯詳等十五人爲公侯，食邑各有差。

translations.literal: That day, an edict enfeoffed fifteen civil and military merit officials including newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry Xiahou Xiang as dukes and marquises, fiefs varying in size.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict enfeoffed fifteen civil and military merit officials, including newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry Xiahou Xiang, as dukes and marquises with fiefs of varying size.

sentences.zh: 以弟中護軍宏爲揚州刺史，封爲臨川郡王；

translations.literal: Younger brother Hong, Central Army Protector, was made Yangzhou Inspector and enfeoffed Prince of Linchuan;
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Hong, Central Army Protector, was made Yangzhou inspector and enfeoffed Prince of Linchuan;

sentences.zh: 南徐州刺史秀安成郡王；

translations.literal: Xiu, South Xu province Inspector, Prince of Ancheng;
translations.idiomatic: Xiu, South Xu province inspector, Prince of Ancheng;

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史偉建安郡王；

translations.literal: Wei, Yong province Inspector, Prince of Jian'an;
translations.idiomatic: Wei, Yong province inspector, Prince of Jian'an;

sentences.zh: 左衛將軍恢鄱陽郡王；

translations.literal: Hui, Left Guard General, Prince of Poyang;
translations.idiomatic: Hui, Left Guard General, Prince of Poyang;

sentences.zh: 荊州刺史憺始興郡王。

translations.literal: Dan, Jing province Inspector, Prince of Shixing.
translations.idiomatic: and Dan, Jing province inspector, Prince of Shixing.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，加領軍將軍王茂鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On dingmao, General Who Leads the Army Wang Mao was additionally given the title General Who Stabilizes the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, General Who Leads the Army Wang Mao was additionally made General Who Stabilizes the Army.

sentences.zh: 以中書監王亮爲尚書令、中軍將軍，相國左長史王瑩爲中書監、撫軍將軍，吏部尚書沈約爲尚書僕射，長兼侍中範雲爲散騎常侍、吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Palace Director Wang Liang was made Director of the Masters of Writing and Central Army General; Chancellor of State Left Chief Clerk Wang Ying was made Palace Director and Pacification Army General; Minister of Personnel Shen Yue was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Chief Concurrent Palace Attendant Fan Yun was made Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Director Wang Liang became Director of the Masters of Writing and Central Army General; Chancellor of State Left Chief Clerk Wang Ying became Palace Director and Pacification Army General; Minister of Personnel Shen Yue became Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Chief Concurrent Palace Attendant Fan Yun became Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「宋氏以來，並恣淫侈，傾宮之富，遂盈數千。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since the Song dynasty, extravagance ran unchecked; the wealth emptied from the palace swelled to thousands.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Since Song, extravagance ran unchecked until the wealth drained from the palace reached thousands.

sentences.zh: 推算五都，愁窮四海，並嬰罹冤橫，拘逼不一。

translations.literal: Calculating across the five capitals, the sorrow and impoverishment filled the four seas; all suffered wrongful affliction, confinement and coercion in countless forms.
translations.idiomatic: Across the five capitals, sorrow and poverty filled the four seas; all suffered wrongful harm, confinement, and coercion in countless forms.

sentences.zh: 撫弦命管，良家不被蠲；

translations.literal: Touching strings and commanding pipes—good families received no exemption;
translations.idiomatic: Musicians were pressed from good families without exemption;

sentences.zh: 織室繡房，幽厄猶見役。

translations.literal: In weaving rooms and embroidery chambers, women in secluded hardship were still pressed to labor.
translations.idiomatic: in weaving rooms and embroidery chambers, women in hidden hardship were still forced to labor.

sentences.zh: 弊國傷和，莫斯爲甚。

translations.literal: Harm to the state and injury to harmony—nothing surpasses this.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing harmed the state and disrupted harmony more than this.

sentences.zh: 凡後宮樂府，西解暴室，諸如此例，一皆放遣。

translations.literal: All palace women's quarters, music offices, Western Release, Violent Chamber, and all such cases shall entirely be discharged.
translations.idiomatic: All palace women's quarters, music offices, Western Release, Violent Chamber, and all such cases are to be discharged.

sentences.zh: 若衰老不能自存，官給廩食。」

translations.literal: If aged and unable to support themselves, the government shall supply grain rations."
translations.idiomatic: Those too old to support themselves are to receive grain from the government."

sentences.zh: 己巳，以光祿大夫張瑰爲右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On jisi, Palace Grandee Zhang Gui was made Right Palace Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Palace Grandee Zhang Gui was made Right Palace Grandee.

sentences.zh: 庚午，鎮南將軍、江州刺史陳伯之進號征南將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, General Who Stabilizes the South and Jiangzhou Inspector Chen Bozhi was promoted to General Who Conquers the South.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, General Who Stabilizes the South and Jiangzhou inspector Chen Bozhi was promoted to General Who Conquers the South.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「觀風省俗，哲后弘規；

translations.literal: An edict said: "Observing the wind and examining custom—enlightened rulers had grand models;
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Observing the wind and examining custom was the grand model of enlightened rulers;

sentences.zh: 狩岳巡方，明王盛軌。

translations.literal: Hunting on the sacred mountains and touring the regions—illumined kings had great precedents.
translations.idiomatic: hunting on the sacred mountains and touring the regions was the great precedent of illumined kings.

sentences.zh: 所以重華在上，五品聿修；

translations.literal: Thus when Chonghua ruled on high, the five ranks were thereby regulated;
translations.idiomatic: Thus when Chonghua ruled, the five ranks were put in order;

sentences.zh: 文命肇基，四載斯履。

translations.literal: When Wenming laid the foundation, over four years he traveled them.
translations.idiomatic: when Wenming laid the foundation, he traveled the realm for four years.

sentences.zh: 故能物色幽微，耳目屠釣，致王業於緝熙，被淳風於遐邇。

translations.literal: Thus could he seek out the obscure and subtle, take fisherfolk and butchers to his ear and eye, bring royal enterprise to bright splendor, and spread pure custom to the far and near.
translations.idiomatic: Thus he could seek out the obscure, take fisherfolk and butchers into his counsel, bring royal enterprise to splendor, and spread pure custom far and near.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡薄，昧于治方，藉代終之運，當符命之重，取監前古，懍若馭朽。

translations.literal: I am scant and slight, ignorant of governance, relying on the fortune of dynastic end, bearing the weight of the mandate's sign—taking warning from antiquity, trembling as one who drives rotten wood.
translations.idiomatic: I am slight and untested, ignorant of governance, bearing the weight of the mandate at a dynastic turning point—taking warning from antiquity, I tremble like one driving rotten wood.

sentences.zh: 思所以振民育德，去殺勝殘，解網更張，置之仁壽；

translations.literal: I think how to revive the people and nourish virtue, replace killing with overcoming cruelty, loosen the net and spread it anew, placing all in benevolence and longevity;
translations.idiomatic: I seek to revive the people and nurture virtue, replace killing with mercy, loosen the net and spread it anew, and place all in benevolence and long life;

sentences.zh: 而明慚照遠，智不周物，兼以歲之不易，未遑卜征，興言夕惕，無忘鑒寐。

translations.literal: Yet my illumination is shamed by its failure to reach far, my wisdom does not compass all things; moreover the year is not easy, and I have not yet been able to set out on tour—speaking of it, I am vigilant evening and morning, never forgetting even in sleep.
translations.idiomatic: yet my light does not reach far enough, my wisdom does not compass all things, and this hard year leaves no time for a tour—I am vigilant evening and morning and cannot forget it even in sleep.

sentences.zh: 可分遣內侍，周省四方，觀政聽謠，訪賢舉滯。

translations.literal: Palace attendants may be dispatched to everywhere survey the four directions, observe government and hear songs, visit the worthy and recommend the stalled.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendants are to be sent out to survey the four directions, observe government and hear folk songs, visit the worthy, and recommend the stalled.

sentences.zh: 其有田野不辟，獄訟無章，忘公殉私，侵漁是務者，悉隨事以聞。

translations.literal: Where fields lie uncultivated, lawsuits lack standards, public duty is forgotten for private gain, or oppression is the sole pursuit—all shall be reported as matters arise.
translations.idiomatic: Where fields lie fallow, lawsuits lack standards, public duty is sacrificed to private gain, or oppression is the sole pursuit—all is to be reported as it arises.

sentences.zh: 若懷寶迷邦，蘊奇待價，蓄響藏真，不求聞達，並依名騰奏，罔或遺隱。

translations.literal: If one hides treasure and loses the state, hoards talent awaiting its price, stores repute and conceals truth, seeking no renown—each shall be memorialized by name, none left out or concealed.
translations.idiomatic: If one hides talent and loses the state, hoards ability awaiting its price, stores repute and conceals truth, seeking no renown—each is to be memorialized by name, none omitted or concealed.

sentences.zh: 使輶軒所屆，如朕親覽焉。」

translations.literal: Where the imperial carriage reaches, it shall be as if I viewed it in person."
translations.idiomatic: Where the imperial carriage reaches, it shall be as if I saw it myself."

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「金作贖刑，有聞自昔，入縑以免，施於中世，民悅法行，莫尚乎此。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "Using metal to redeem punishment was known from old; paying silk to avoid penalty was applied in the middle age—the people delighted in the law's operation, nothing was more esteemed.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said, "Redeeming punishment with metal was known from old, and paying silk to avoid penalty was used in the middle age—the people delighted in the law, and nothing was more esteemed.

sentences.zh: 永言叔世，偷薄成風，嬰諐入罪，厥塗匪一。

translations.literal: Long have I spoken of the declining age—pettiness became the wind; infants falling into guilt, the paths thereof are not one.
translations.idiomatic: Long have I lamented the declining age, when pettiness became the wind and even infants fell into guilt by many paths.

sentences.zh: 斷弊之書，日纏於聽覽；

translations.literal: Documents cutting off evils daily entangle my hearing and sight;
translations.idiomatic: Documents cutting off abuses daily crowd my hearing and sight;

sentences.zh: 鉗钅犬之刑，歲積於牢犴。

translations.literal: Fetter and cangue punishments year upon year pile in the prisons.
translations.idiomatic: fetter and cangue punishments pile year upon year in the prisons.

sentences.zh: 死者不可復生，刑者無因自返，由此而望滋實，庸可致乎？

translations.literal: The dead cannot live again; the punished have no means to return on their own—from this how can one expect the population to increase and fields to thrive?
translations.idiomatic: The dead cannot live again, and the punished cannot return on their own—how then can the population grow and the fields flourish?

sentences.zh: 朕夕惕思治，念崇政術，斟酌前王，擇其令典，有可以憲章邦國，罔不由之。

translations.literal: I am vigilantly thoughtful of governance evening by evening, intent on elevating the art of rule, weighing the former kings and selecting their fine statutes—what can serve as law and model for the realm, none shall fail to follow it.
translations.idiomatic: I think of governance every evening, intent on elevating the art of rule, weighing the former kings and choosing their fine statutes—what can serve as law for the realm, none shall fail to follow.

sentences.zh: 釋愧心於四海，昭情素於萬物。

translations.literal: Release a shamed heart before the four seas, declare sincerity and plainness to the ten thousand things.
translations.idiomatic: I would release shame before the four seas and declare plain sincerity to the ten thousand things.

sentences.zh: 俗偽日久，禁網彌繁。

translations.literal: Custom has been false long; prohibitions and nets grow ever more numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Custom has long been false, and prohibitions and nets grow ever more numerous.

sentences.zh: 漢文四百，邈焉已遠。

translations.literal: Four hundred years since Han Wendi—how distant already.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred years have passed since Han Wendi—how distant that seems.

sentences.zh: 雖省事清心，無忘日用，而委銜廢策，事未獲從。

translations.literal: Though I reduce affairs and clear the heart, not forgetting daily use, yet entrusting the reins and abandoning plans—the matter has not yet been achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Though I reduce affairs and clear the heart, not forgetting daily governance, the plan to loosen the reins has not yet been achieved.

sentences.zh: 可依周、漢舊典，有罪入贖，外詳爲條格，以時奏聞。」

translations.literal: We may follow Zhou and Han old statutes—those guilty may redeem by payment; details shall be set out as articles and submitted in due time."
translations.idiomatic: We may follow Zhou and Han old statutes and allow the guilty to redeem by payment; detailed articles are to be drawn up and submitted in due time."

sentences.zh: 辛未，以中領軍蔡道恭爲司州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Central Army Commander Cai Daogong was made Si province Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Central Army Commander Cai Daogong was made Si province inspector.

sentences.zh: 以新除謝沐縣公蕭寶義爲巴陵王，以奉齊祀。

translations.literal: The newly dismissed Duke of Xiemu county Xiao Baoyi was made Prince of Baling, to maintain Qi ancestral rites.
translations.idiomatic: The newly dismissed Duke of Xiemu county Xiao Baoyi was made Prince of Baling to maintain Qi ancestral rites.

sentences.zh: 復南蘭陵武進縣，依前代之科。

translations.literal: Restore Nan Lanling's Wujin county according to former dynasties' statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Nan Lanling's Wujin county was restored according to former dynasties' statutes.

sentences.zh: 徵謝朏爲左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，何胤爲右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Xie Tiao was summoned as Left Supernumerary Grand Master and Bearer of the Staff with the Same Three Dignities as the Three Lords; He Yin was made Right Supernumerary Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Tiao was appointed Left Supernumerary Grand Master with full ministerial honors; He Yin became Right Supernumerary Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 改南東海爲蘭陵郡。

translations.literal: South Donghai was changed to Lanling commandery.
translations.idiomatic: South Donghai commandery was renamed Lanling.

sentences.zh: 土斷南徐州諸僑郡縣。

translations.literal: Land registration was applied to all refugee commanderies and counties of South Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The court fixed land tenure for every refugee district in South Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔曰：「商俗甫移，遺風尚熾，下不上達，由來遠矣。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, an edict said: "The customs of Shang have only just shifted, yet the old ways still burn bright; that what lies below does not reach those above has been so from of old.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict declared, "Shang ways have barely changed, but old habits still run hot; the grievances of the low never reach the high—and that has been true for ages.

sentences.zh: 升中馭索，增其懍然。

translations.literal: To ascend the central peak and drive the chariot—how much more should one feel awe and reverence.
translations.idiomatic: To climb the sacred height and hold the reins should fill one with dread and humility.

sentences.zh: 可於公車府謗木肺石傍各置一函。

translations.literal: At the Palace Coach Office, beside the suggestion post and the accusation stone, one letter receptacle may be placed at each.
translations.idiomatic: Place a letter box beside the suggestion post and another beside the accusation stone at the Palace Coach Office.

sentences.zh: 若肉食莫言，山阿欲有橫議，投謗木函。

translations.literal: If those who eat flesh remain silent, and in the mountain recesses there are those who wish to speak freely, let them deposit their words in the suggestion post receptacle.
translations.idiomatic: If men at court stay mute while voices in the hills wish to speak, let them put their words in the suggestion box.

sentences.zh: 若從我江、漢，功在可策，犀兕徒弊，龍蛇方縣；

translations.literal: If one follows me from the Jiang and Han, with merit that can be reckoned, yet rhinoceros and buffalo are wasted and dragon and serpent still hang in suspension;
translations.idiomatic: If you marched with me from the Jiang and Han, your deeds worth recording, yet fine talent goes unused while great men still wait in the wings;

sentences.zh: 次身才高妙，擯壓莫通，懷傅、呂之術，抱屈、賈之歎，其理有皦然，受困包匭；

translations.literal: or if one's talent is lofty and refined, yet blocked and pressed with no outlet, bearing the arts of Fu Yue and Lü Shang, carrying the sighs of Qu Yuan and Jia Yi—with reason plain yet trapped, suffering confinement like goods in a chest;
translations.idiomatic: or if your gifts are bright but you are shut out, holding the skill of Fu and Lü yet sighing like Qu and Jia—your case clear as day, yet you languish unseen in a box;

sentences.zh: 夫大政侵小，豪門陵賤，四民已窮，九重莫達。

translations.literal: When great affairs encroach on the small and noble gates trample the lowly, the four classes are already exhausted, yet the ninefold palace cannot be reached.
translations.idiomatic: When power crushes the weak and great houses ride over the humble, the people are spent and no cry reaches the throne.

sentences.zh: 若欲自申，並可投肺石函。」

translations.literal: If one wishes to plead one's case, one may also deposit it in the accusation stone receptacle."
translations.idiomatic: If you wish to state your grievance, put it in the accusation box as well."

sentences.zh: 甲戍，詔斷遠近上慶禮。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, an edict cut off congratulatory rites from near and far.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court forbade congratulatory offerings from every quarter.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「禮闈文閣，宜率舊章，貴賤旣位，各有差等，俯仰拜伏，以明王度，濟濟洋洋，具瞻斯在。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "In the ritual halls and literary pavilions one should follow the old statutes; nobles and commoners, once in place, each have their ranks; bowing and prostration should make the king's measure clear—solemn and grand, all eyes upon them.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict read, "Court ritual and the halls of learning must follow ancient rule. Rank high or low, each man in his place should bow and rise to show the king's order—stately, orderly, worthy of every eye.

sentences.zh: 頃因多難，治綱弛落，官非積及，榮由幸至。

translations.literal: Recently, because of many troubles, governing ties have slackened; offices are not gained through accumulation, and honor comes through favor.
translations.idiomatic: Lately endless turmoil has loosened the bonds of rule. Posts no longer come from long service; rank arrives by luck alone.

sentences.zh: 六軍尸四品之職，青紫治白簿之勞。

translations.literal: The Six Armies occupy fourth-rank posts; purple and green robes handle white-ledger labor.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers of the Six Armies hold fourth-rank offices; men in purple and green do the work of clerks.

sentences.zh: 振衣朝伍，長揖卿相，趨步廣闥，並驅丞郎。

translations.literal: They shake out robes in court ranks, make long bows to ministers and chancellors, hurry steps through broad gates, and drive alongside assistant directors and bureau chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: They strut in the morning ranks, bow casually to ministers, stride through broad gates, and ride neck and neck with junior secretaries.

sentences.zh: 遂冠履倒錯，珪甑莫辨。

translations.literal: Thus hat and shoes are reversed, and jade and pottery cannot be distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Hat and shoe are turned upside down; jade regalia and common pottery look the same.

sentences.zh: 靜言疚懷，思返流弊。

translations.literal: Silent reflection brings remorse; I think to reverse these flowing abuses.
translations.idiomatic: When I sit in silence, shame fills me. I mean to turn back this tide of decay.

sentences.zh: 且翫法惰官，動成逋弛，罰以常科，終未懲革。

translations.literal: Moreover those who sport with the law and slacken in office, at every turn become derelict—punishing by ordinary statutes still does not reform them.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who treat the law as a toy and neglect their duties grow slack at every step. Ordinary penalties no longer change them.

sentences.zh: 夫檟楚申威，蓋代斷趾，笞捶有令，如或可從。

translations.literal: Flogging to display authority—in antiquity it substituted for cutting off feet; the whip and cudgel have statutes, which perhaps may be followed.
translations.idiomatic: The rod and lash once stood for royal awe—in old times they replaced cutting off the feet. Whipping has its rule; perhaps we should use it again.

sentences.zh: 外詳共平議，務盡厥理。」

translations.literal: Let the outer court examine and discuss together calmly, striving to exhaust the principle."
translations.idiomatic: Let the outer court debate this openly and settle what is right."

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔「相國府職吏，可依資勞度臺；

translations.literal: On day guiwei, an edict: "Chancellor of State office clerks may, according to seniority and merit, be assessed for appointment to the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day an edict said, "Clerks of the Chancellor of State may, by seniority and service, be considered for Secretariat posts;

sentences.zh: 若職限已盈，所度之餘，及驃騎府並可賜滿。」

translations.literal: if the quota of posts is already filled, the remainder of those assessed, as well as the Rapid Cavalry office, may all be granted full appointment."
translations.idiomatic: if the posts are full, the rest—and those of the Rapid Cavalry office as well—may receive full rank all the same."

sentences.zh: 閏月丁酉，以行宕昌王梁彌邕爲安西將軍、河涼二州刺史，正封宕昌王。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on day dingyou, Acting Prince of Dangchang Liang Miyong was made General Who Pacifies the West, Inspector of He and Liang two provinces, and formally enfeoffed Prince of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the leap month, on dingyou day, Acting Prince of Dangchang Liang Miyong became General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of He and Liang, and was formally enfeoffed Prince of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以車騎將軍夏侯詳爲右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On day renyin, General of Chariots and Cavalry Xiahou Xiang was made Right Supernumerary Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day General of Chariots and Cavalry Xiahou Xiang was appointed Right Supernumerary Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「成務弘風，肅厲內外，實由設官分職，互相懲糾。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Accomplishing tasks and spreading custom, making inner and outer solemn and strict—this truly comes from dividing offices and apportioning duties, mutually restraining and checking one another.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared, "Great work and upright custom, discipline within and without—these come from clear offices, divided duties, and men who check one another.

sentences.zh: 而頃壹拘常式，見失方奏，多容違惰，莫肯執咎，憲綱日弛，漸以爲俗，今端右可以風聞奏事，依元熙舊制。」

translations.literal: But recently all adhere to fixed forms; only when loss is seen is it reported; much lax violation is tolerated, and none will bear blame—the penal net slackens daily and gradually becomes custom. Now those of the right rank may report on hearsay, following the old system of Yuanxi."
translations.idiomatic: Lately everyone clings to routine. Wrongdoing is reported only after harm is done. Neglect is indulged and no one accepts blame. The law grows slack day by day until slackness itself is custom. From now on the chief ministers may report what they hear, as in the Yuanxi era."

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥夜，盜入南、北掖，燒神虎門、總章觀，害衛尉卿張弘策。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the night of day yihai, thieves entered the Southern and Northern Side Gates, burned Shenhu Gate and Zongzhang View, and killed Commandant of the Guards Zhang Hongce.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the night of yihai day, robbers broke into the Southern and Northern Side Gates, set fire to Shenhu Gate and Zongzhang View, and killed Commandant of the Guards Zhang Hongce.

sentences.zh: 戊子，江州刺史陳伯之舉兵反，以領軍將軍王茂爲征南將軍、江州刺史，率衆討之。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Jiangzhou Inspector Chen Bozhi raised troops in rebellion; Staff Officer of the Army Wang Mao was made General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou Inspector to lead the host against him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Jiangzhou inspector Chen Bozhi rebelled with an army. Staff Officer of the Army Wang Mao was made General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou inspector and sent to crush him.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，以行北秦州刺史楊紹先爲北秦州刺史、武都王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day gengxu, Acting North Qinzhou Inspector Yang Shaoixian was made North Qinzhou Inspector and Prince of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu day, Acting North Qinzhou inspector Yang Shaoixian became North Qinzhou inspector and Prince of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 是月，陳伯之奔魏，江州平。

translations.literal: That month, Chen Bozhi fled to Wei; Jiangzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chen Bozhi fled to Wei and Jiangzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 前益州刺史劉季連據成都反。

translations.literal: Former Yizhou Inspector Liu Jilian held Chengdu in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Former Yizhou inspector Liu Jilian seized Chengdu and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，置建康三官。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day wuxu, the Three Offices of Jiankang were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuxu day, the Three Offices of Jiankang were created.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，平北將軍、西涼州刺史象舒彭進號安西將軍，封鄧至王。

translations.literal: On day yisi, General Who Pacifies the North and West Liangzhou Inspector Xiang Shupeng was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West and enfeoffed Prince of Dengzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day General Who Pacifies the North and West Liangzhou inspector Xiang Shupeng was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West and enfeoffed Prince of Dengzhi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔中書監王瑩等八人參定律令。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, an edict ordered Secretariat Supervisor Wang Ying and eight others to jointly compile laws and ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the court ordered Secretariat supervisor Wang Ying and eight others to draft laws and ordinances together.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔尚書曹郎依昔奏事。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered Ministry of State Affairs bureau chiefs to report business as before.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict restored the old practice of Ministry bureau chiefs presenting business directly.

sentences.zh: 林邑、干陁利國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Linyi and Gandhari each sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Linyi and Gandhari each sent envoys with local tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己未，立小廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day jiwei, the Lesser Temple was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiwei day, the Lesser Temple was established.

sentences.zh: 甲子，立皇子統爲皇太子。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor's son Tong was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the emperor's son Tong was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，以國子祭酒張稷爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on day bingshen, National University Chancellor Zhang Ji was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingshen day, National University chancellor Zhang Ji was made General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，護軍將軍張稷免。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, General Who Protects the Army Zhang Ji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day General Who Protects the Army Zhang Ji was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 是歲大旱，米斗五千，人多餓死。

translations.literal: That year there was great drought; rice at five thousand per peck, and many people starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought struck hard. A peck of rice cost five thousand cash, and many starved.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲寅朔，詔曰：「三訊五聽，著自聖典，哀矜折獄，義重前誥，蓋所以明慎用刑，深戒疑枉，成功致治，罔不由茲。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year, on the first day of the first month, day jiayin, an edict said: "Three inquiries and five hearings are recorded in the sage classics; pitying and weighing cases weighs in former commands. Thus to make clear careful use of punishments and deeply guard against wrongful suspicion—in achieving order, none do not proceed from this.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 2, on the new moon of the first month, jiayin day, an edict said, "Three inquiries and five hearings belong to the sage canon. Mercy in judgment was prized by our forebears. Care in punishment and fear of wrongful conviction—the path to good rule runs through both.

sentences.zh: 朕自籓部，常躬訊錄，求理得情，洪細必盡。

translations.literal: From my time in the fief I personally examined and recorded, seeking the principle and obtaining the truth, great and small all exhaustively addressed.
translations.idiomatic: When I held my fief I heard cases myself, seeking truth in every matter, large or small, until nothing was left untried.

sentences.zh: 末運弛網，斯政又闕，牢犴沉壅，申訴靡從。

translations.literal: At the age's end the net slackened, this governance was again lacking—prisons choked, and appeals had nowhere to go.
translations.idiomatic: In the late age the net slackened and this practice fell away. Prisons clogged, and the wronged had no one to hear them.

sentences.zh: 朕屬當期運，君臨兆億，雖復齋居宣室，留心聽斷；

translations.literal: I have inherited the timely destiny and face the myriad masses; though I dwell in fasting in the Xuan Chamber and attend to judgments,
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's charge is mine and the realm looks to me. Though I fast in the Xuan Chamber and weigh every case,

sentences.zh: 而九牧遐荒，無因臨覽。

translations.literal: yet the nine pasturelands are far and wild—I cannot personally oversee.
translations.idiomatic: the nine provinces stretch far into the wilds, and I cannot see them with my own eyes.

sentences.zh: 深懼懷冤就鞫，匪惟一方。

translations.literal: I deeply fear that those harboring injustice coming to judgment is not only in one place.
translations.idiomatic: I fear the wronged are judged unfairly not in one place alone, but everywhere.

sentences.zh: 可申敕諸州，月一臨訊，博詢擇善，務在確實。

translations.literal: Command may be sent to all provinces: once a month personally conduct hearings, broadly inquire and choose the good, striving for certainty.
translations.idiomatic: Let every province be ordered to hold hearings once a month, to inquire widely, choose what is sound, and seek the truth.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，以尚書僕射沈約爲尚書左僕射；

translations.literal: On day yimao, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Yue was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing;
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Yue became Left Vice Director;

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書范雲爲尚書右僕射；

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Fan Yun was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing;
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Fan Yun became Right Vice Director;

sentences.zh: 前將軍鄱陽王恢爲南徐州刺史；

translations.literal: Former General Prince of Poyang Hui was made South Xuzhou Inspector;
translations.idiomatic: Former general Prince of Poyang Hui was made South Xuzhou inspector;

sentences.zh: 尚書令王亮爲左光祿大夫；

translations.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang was made Left Supernumerary Grand Master;
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang was made Left Supernumerary Grand Master;

sentences.zh: 右衛將軍柳慶遠爲中領軍。

translations.literal: Right Guard General Liu Qingyuan was made Commander of the Army Central.
translations.idiomatic: Right Guard General Liu Qingyuan was made Central Army Commander.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，尚書令、新除左光祿大夫王亮免。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Director of the Masters of Writing and newly appointed Left Supernumerary Grand Master Wang Liang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang, newly made Left Supernumerary Grand Master, was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，尚書刪定郎蔡法度上《梁律》二十卷、《令》三十卷、《科》四十卷。

translations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on day guimao, Review and Determination Bureau Chief Cai Fadu presented the Liang Code in twenty juan, Ordinances in thirty juan, and Administrative Precedents in forty juan.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on guimao day, Review Bureau chief Cai Fadu submitted the Liang Code in twenty scrolls, Ordinances in thirty, and Administrative Precedents in forty.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，尚書右僕射範雲卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day dingsi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Fan Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingsi day, Right Vice Director Fan Yun died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，益州刺史鄧元起克成都，曲赦益州。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Yizhou Inspector Deng Yuanqi captured Chengdu; a partial amnesty was granted for Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Yizhou inspector Deng Yuanqi took Chengdu, and Yizhou received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 壬申，斷諸郡縣獻奉二宮。

translations.literal: On day renshen, tribute from all commanderies and counties to the Two Palaces was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the court ended tribute from every commandery and county to the Two Palaces.

sentences.zh: 惟諸州及會稽，職惟嶽牧，許薦任土，若非地產，亦不得貢。

translations.literal: Only the provinces and Kuaiji—since their duty is as mountain-lord governors—may recommend local products; if not local produce, they may not offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Only the provinces and Kuaiji, whose officers serve as territorial lords, may present what the land yields. If it is not a local product, it may not be sent as tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，詔以東陽、信安、豊安三縣水潦，漂損居民資業，遣使周履，量蠲課調。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day dinghai, an edict said that because Dongyang, Xin'an, and Feng'an three counties suffered flood damage to residents' property, envoys were sent to survey and reduce levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dinghai day, an edict said floods in Dongyang, Xin'an, and Feng'an had ruined homes and fields. Envoys were sent to survey the damage and cut taxes.

sentences.zh: 是夏多癘疫。

translations.literal: That summer there was much pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: That summer plague spread widely.

sentences.zh: 以新除左光祿大夫謝朏爲司徒、尚書令。

translations.literal: The newly dismissed Left Supernumerary Grand Master Xie Tiao was made Minister of Works and Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: The newly dismissed Left Supernumerary Grand Master Xie Tiao was made Minister of Works and Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以中書監王瑩爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Secretariat Supervisor Wang Ying was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Secretariat supervisor Wang Ying became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，扶南、龜茲、中天竺國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, Funan, Kucha, and Central India each sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, Funan, Kucha, and Central India each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，魏寇司州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Wei raided Si province.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Wei invaded Si province.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，雷電大雨，晦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on day yimao, there was thunder, lightning, and great rain; it was the last day of the month.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yimao day, thunder, lightning, and heavy rain fell on the month's last day.

sentences.zh: 是夜又雷。

translations.literal: That night there was thunder again.
translations.idiomatic: That night thunder sounded again.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，尚書左僕射沈約以母憂去職。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Yue left office on account of his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Left Vice Director Shen Yue left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月戊申，後將軍、揚州刺史臨川王宏進號中軍將軍。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year, on day wushen of the first month, Rear General, Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong was promoted to General of the Center Army.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 3, on wushen day in the first month, Rear General and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong was promoted to General of the Center Army.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以尚書右僕射王瑩爲尚書左僕射，太子詹事柳惔爲尚書右僕射，前尚書左僕射沈約爲鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Ying was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Crown Prince Tutor Liu Tan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; former Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Yue was made General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Right Vice Director Wang Ying became Left Vice Director; Crown Prince tutor Liu Tan became Right Vice Director; and former Left Vice Director Shen Yue was made General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 二月，魏陷梁州。

translations.literal: In the second month, Wei captured Liang province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Wei took Liang province.

sentences.zh: 三月，隕霜殺草。

translations.literal: In the third month, frost fell and killed the grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month frost fell and killed the grass.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，以扶南國王憍陳如闍耶跋摩爲安南將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day dingsi, King of Funan Jiao Chen Ru Jian Ye Ba Mo was made General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingsi day, King of Funan Jiao Chen Ru Jian Ye Ba Mo was made General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，詔曰：「昔哲王之宰世也，每歲卜征，躬事巡省，民俗政刑，罔不必逮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day bingzi, an edict said: "Ancient wise kings governing the age, every year chose the campaign season and personally made inspection tours—customs, government, and punishments—none were not reached.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, an edict said, "Wise kings of old, ruling the world, each year chose the season for travel and went in person to inspect the land. Custom, government, and punishment—nothing escaped their sight.

sentences.zh: 末代風凋，久曠茲典。

translations.literal: At the age's end customs withered; this rite has long been abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: In later ages custom faded, and this rite has long lain empty.

sentences.zh: 雖欲肆遠忘勞，究臨幽仄，而居今行古，事未易從，所以日晏踟躕，情同再撫。

translations.literal: Though I wish to go far and forget fatigue, personally reaching the hidden corners—living in the present while acting the ancient is not easy to follow; therefore day after day I hesitate, my feelings like doubly caressing.
translations.idiomatic: I would travel far, forget weariness, and reach the remotest corners myself—but to live in the present while acting like the ancients is hard. Day after day I hesitate, longing to go out and comfort the people twice over.

sentences.zh: 總總九州，遠近民庶，或川路幽遐，或貧羸老疾，懷冤抱理，莫由自申，所以東海匹婦，致災邦國，西土孤魂，登樓請訴。

translations.literal: Throughout the nine regions, near and far, among the people—some routes blocked by rivers, some poor, weak, aged, or ill—holding injustice and embracing reason with no way to plead—thus the lone woman of Donghai brought disaster on the state, and the solitary soul of the western lands climbed a tower to plead.
translations.idiomatic: Across the nine regions, near and far, some people are cut off by rivers, some are poor, weak, old, or sick. They hold injustice in their hearts and have no way to speak. A lone woman in Donghai once brought ruin on her state; a solitary soul in the west climbed a tower to cry for justice.

sentences.zh: 念此于懷，中夜太息。

translations.literal: Thinking of this in my heart, I sigh at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: When I think of this, I sigh in the deep of night.

sentences.zh: 可分將命巡行州部。

translations.literal: Commissions may be divided to send envoys to tour the provinces and departments.
translations.idiomatic: Let envoys be dispatched to tour the provinces and departments.

sentences.zh: 其有深冤鉅害，抑鬱無歸，聽詣使者，依源自列。

translations.literal: Those with deep injustice and great harm, depressed with no recourse—permit them to come to the envoys and according to origin state their case.
translations.idiomatic: Those who suffer grave wrongs with no one to hear them may come to the envoys and state their case as it arose.

sentences.zh: 庶以矜隱之念，昭被四方，逷聽遠聞，事均親覽。

translations.literal: Perhaps thereby the thought of pitying and hiding may shine over the four quarters, and hearing from afar may equal viewing in person.
translations.idiomatic: Then mercy may reach the four quarters, and what is heard from afar may be judged as if seen by the throne itself."

sentences.zh: 」癸未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, a general amnesty was granted for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，以光祿大夫夏侯詳爲車騎將軍、湘州刺史，湘州刺史楊公則爲中護軍。

translations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on day dingwei, Supernumerary Grand Master Xiahou Xiang was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Xiangzhou Inspector; Xiangzhou Inspector Yang Gongze was made General Who Guards the Army Central.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, on dingwei day, Supernumerary Grand Master Xiahou Xiang became General of Chariots and Cavalry and Xiangzhou inspector; Xiangzhou inspector Yang Gongze became Central Army Guard General.

sentences.zh: 甲子，立皇子綜爲豫章郡王。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor's son Zong was established as Prince of Yuzhang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the emperor's son Zong was made Prince of Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 八月，魏陷司州，詔以南義陽置司州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Wei captured Si province; an edict ordered South Yiyang to be established as Si province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wei took Si province. The court ordered South Yiyang to serve as the new Si province.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，以河南王世子伏連籌爲鎮西將軍、西秦河二州刺史、河南王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day renzi, Heir of the Prince of Henan Fu Lianchou was made General Who Pacifies the West, Inspector of West Qin and He two provinces, and Prince of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi day, Heir of the Prince of Henan Fu Lianchou became General Who Pacifies the West, inspector of West Qin and He, and Prince of Henan.

sentences.zh: 北天竺國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: North India sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: North India sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲子，詔曰：「設教因時，淳薄異政，刑以世革，輕重殊風。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day jiazi, an edict said: "Establishing teaching according to the times—pure and crude differ in governance; punishments change with the age—light and heavy differ in custom.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiazi day, an edict said, "Teaching must follow the times. Pure ages and coarse ages govern differently. Punishment changes with the age; what is heavy in one era is light in another.

sentences.zh: 昔商俗未移，民散久矣，嬰網陷辟，日夜相尋。

translations.literal: Formerly, when Shang customs had not shifted, the people had long been scattered; entangled in nets and fallen into punishments, day and night they pursued one another.
translations.idiomatic: Once, before custom had changed, the people had long been scattered. Caught in nets of law, they fell into punishment and chased one another day and night.

sentences.zh: 若悉加正法，則赭衣塞路；

translations.literal: If all were punished by the full law, those in red prison garments would fill the roads;
translations.idiomatic: If every offense were punished to the letter, men in red prison dress would choke the roads;

sentences.zh: 並申弘宥，則難用爲國，故使有罪入贖，以全元元之命。

translations.literal: if all were granted broad mercy, it would be hard to use as a state—therefore those guilty were permitted to ransom, to preserve the lives of the masses.
translations.idiomatic: yet if mercy were granted to all, the state could not stand. So the guilty were allowed to ransom their lives and the common people were spared.

sentences.zh: 今遐邇知禁，圄犴稍虛，率斯以往，庶幾刑措。

translations.literal: Now near and far know prohibition; prisons gradually empty—following this forward, perhaps punishments may be set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Now far and near know the law, and the prisons grow empty. If we continue on this path, perhaps punishments may one day fall still.

sentences.zh: 金作權典，宜在蠲息。

translations.literal: The gold-standard punishment statute should be suspended and ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The statute of punishments measured in gold should now be lifted and stilled.

sentences.zh: 可除贖罪之科。」

translations.literal: The ransom-for-crime statute may be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: The law allowing ransom for crime may be abolished."

sentences.zh: 是歲多疾疫。

translations.literal: That year there was much pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: That year plague ran through the land.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸卯朔，詔曰：「今九流常選，年未三十，不通一經，不得解褐。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year, on the first day of the first month, day guimao, an edict said: "For the regular selection of the nine streams, if under thirty years of age and not passing one classic, one may not leave coarse cloth and enter office.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 4, on the new moon of the first month, guimao day, an edict said, "In the regular selection of officials, no man under thirty who has not mastered one classic may leave coarse cloth and take office.

sentences.zh: 若有才同甘、顏，勿限年次。

translations.literal: If talent matches Gan or Yan, do not limit by age."
translations.idiomatic: If talent equals Gan or Yan, do not bind it by age.

sentences.zh: 」置《五經》博士各一人。

translations.literal: Five Classics Erudites were established, one for each.
translations.idiomatic: One Erudite was appointed for each of the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 以鎮北將軍、雍州刺史、建安王偉爲南徐州刺史，南徐州刺史鄱陽王恢爲郢州刺史，中領軍柳慶遠爲雍州刺史。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the North, Yongzhou Inspector Prince of Jian'an Wei was made South Xuzhou Inspector; South Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Poyang Hui was made Yingzhou Inspector; Commander of the Army Central Liu Qingyuan was made Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the North and Yongzhou inspector Prince of Jian'an Wei became South Xuzhou inspector; South Xuzhou inspector Prince of Poyang Hui became Yingzhou inspector; and Central Army Commander Liu Qingyuan became Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 丙午，省《鳳皇銜書伎》。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Phoenix Bearing the Book troupe was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On day bingwu, the court abolished the Phoenix Bearing the Book performance.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「夫禋郊饗帝，至敬攸在，致誠盡愨，猶懼有違；

translations.literal: On day wushen, an edict said: "In sacrificial offerings at the suburban altars and feasts to the Lord on High, the utmost reverence lies therein; with utmost sincerity and diligence one still fears falling short;
translations.idiomatic: On day wushen, an edict said, "To sacrifice at the suburban altars and feast the Lord on High is the highest reverence; even with full sincerity one still fears some lapse;

sentences.zh: 而往代多令宮人縱觀茲禮，帷宮廣設，輜軿耀路，非所以仰虔蒼昊，昭感上靈。

translations.literal: yet past ages often had palace women watch this rite at will; canopy-palaces were widely set up and curtained carriages glittered on the roads—not the way to look up in reverence to azure Heaven and manifest gratitude to the divine.
translations.idiomatic: yet earlier reigns often let palace women come and watch at will, with canopy-pavilions strung along the route and curtained carriages blazing on every road—not how one should bow before azure Heaven and show the upper powers one's heart.

sentences.zh: 屬車之間，見譏前世，便可自今停止。

translations.literal: Among the retinue chariots, past ages were criticized for this—henceforth let it be stopped from today.
translations.idiomatic: The retinue itself was mocked in former times for this; from today it shall cease.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，輿駕親祠南郊，赦天下。

translations.literal: " On day xinhai, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburban Altar and pardoned the realm.
translations.idiomatic: " On day xinhai, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburban Altar in person and pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，遣衛尉卿楊公則率宿衛兵塞洛口。

translations.literal: In the second month, on day renwu, Commandant of Guards Yang Gongze was sent to lead palace guards to block Luokou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day renwu, Commandant of Guards Yang Gongze led the palace guard to seal Luokou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，交州刺史李凱據州反，長史李畟討平之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Jiaozhou Inspector Li Kai seized the province in rebellion; Chief Clerk Li Di put the revolt down.
translations.idiomatic: On day renchen, Jiaozhou inspector Li Kai rebelled and held the province; chief clerk Li Di crushed him.

sentences.zh: 曲赦交州。

translations.literal: A partial pardon was granted to Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhou received a special pardon.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以前郢州刺史曹景宗爲中護軍。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, former Yingzhou Inspector Cao Jingzong was made Central Protector General.
translations.idiomatic: On day wuxu, former Yingzhou inspector Cao Jingzong was appointed Central Protector General.

sentences.zh: 是月，立建興苑於秣陵建興里。

translations.literal: That month, Jianxing Park was established at Jianxing lane in Moling.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court established Jianxing Park in Jianxing lane, Moling.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，以行宕昌王梁彌博爲安西將軍、河涼二州刺史、宕昌王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on day dingsi, Acting King of Dangchang Liang Mibo was made General Who Pacifies the West, Inspector of He and Liang provinces, and King of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, day dingsi, Acting King of Dangchang Liang Mibo was made General Who Pacifies the West, inspector of He and Liang, and King of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 是月，自甲寅至壬戌，甘露連降華林園。

translations.literal: That month, from day jiayin to day renxu, sweet dew fell continuously in Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: That month, from jiayin through renxu, sweet dew fell again and again in Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，建康縣朔陰里生嘉禾，一莖十二穗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day xinmao, auspicious grain grew in Shuoyin lane, Jiankang county—one stalk bearing twelve ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on day xinmao, Jiankang county's Shuoyin lane produced auspicious grain: one stalk with twelve ears.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，立孔子廟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day gengxu, the Temple of Confucius was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on day gengxu, a temple to Confucius was established.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Jupiter was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On day renxu, Jupiter appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，右光祿大夫張瓌卒。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on day xinmao, Right Grandee for Splendid Merit Zhang Gui died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, day xinmao, Right Grandee for Splendid Merit Zhang Gui died.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day gengzi, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on day gengzi, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，北伐，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史臨川王宏都督北討諸軍事，尚書右僕射柳惔爲副。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on day bingwu, the Northern Campaign began; Central Army General and Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong was made overall commander of Northern Expedition forces, with Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Yan as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, day bingwu, the Northern Campaign opened; Central Army General and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong took overall command of the northern expedition, with Right Vice Director Liu Yan as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 是歲，以興師費用，王公以下各上國租及田穀，以助軍資。

translations.literal: That year, because of the cost of raising troops, princes and dukes downward each submitted land rents and field grain to assist military funds.
translations.idiomatic: That year, to meet the cost of war, every prince and duke down the ranks offered land rents and field grain for the army.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，以都官尚書張稷爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on day xinwei, Director of the Masters of Writing for Capital Crimes Zhang Ji was made Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on day xinwei, Capital Crimes Director Zhang Ji was made Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，天晴朗，西南有電光，聞如雷聲三。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the sky was clear; in the southwest there was lightning, and thunder was heard three times.
translations.idiomatic: On day jiawu the sky was bright and clear, yet lightning flashed in the southwest and thunder rolled three times.

sentences.zh: 十二月，司徒、尚書令謝朏以所生母憂，去職。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Chancellor of State and Director of the Masters of Writing Xie Tiao took mourning for his birth mother and left office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Chancellor of State and Director of the Masters of Writing Xie Tiao left office to mourn his birth mother.

sentences.zh: 是歲大穰，米斛三十。

translations.literal: That year brought a great harvest; rice was thirty cash per hu.
translations.idiomatic: That year the harvest was abundant; rice sold for thirty cash the hu.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁卯朔，詔曰：「在昔周、漢，取士方國。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the first day dingmao, an edict said: "In the past Zhou and Han took scholars from the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, spring, first month, first day dingmao, an edict said, "In olden days Zhou and Han drew their scholars from every quarter of the realm.

sentences.zh: 頃代凋訛，幽仄罕被，人孤地絕，用隔聽覽，士操淪胥，因茲靡勸。

translations.literal: In recent generations decline and error prevailed; remote and obscure talent was rarely reached; people were isolated and places cut off, blocking imperial hearing; scholarly conduct sank, and thus encouragement failed.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages decayed, and men in hidden corners seldom reached the throne; cut off by distance and desolation, their voices never reached the court, talent withered, and no one was moved to strive.

sentences.zh: 豈其岳瀆縱靈，偏有厚薄，實由知與不知，用與不用耳。

translations.literal: Is it that mountains and rivers release spirit unevenly, favoring some and not others? No—it is truly because of knowing and not knowing, employing and not employing.
translations.idiomatic: Is it that the mountains and rivers breathe out spirit with partial favor? No—the difference lies only in whether talent is seen and used.

sentences.zh: 朕以菲德，君此兆民，而兼明廣照，屈於堂戶，飛耳長目，不及四方，永言愧懷，無忘旦夕。

translations.literal: I with meager virtue rule these myriad people, yet broad enlightenment and wide illumination are confined within hall and door; flying ear and long eye cannot reach the four directions—forever I speak with ashamed heart, forgetting not morning nor evening.
translations.idiomatic: I am of little merit, yet I rule the myriad people; though my light should shine far, it stays trapped within these halls, and my ears and eyes cannot reach the four quarters. I am ashamed morning and night, and cannot put this from my mind.

sentences.zh: 凡諸郡國舊族，邦內無在朝位者，選官搜括，使郡有一人。

translations.literal: All old families of every commandery and kingdom that have no one in court office—let selection officers search and see that each commandery has one.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever an old clan in a commandery or kingdom has no one in court office, let the selection officers search them out so that every commandery may send at least one man.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，以前司徒謝朏爲中書監、司徒、衛將軍，鎮軍將軍沈約爲右光祿大夫，豫章王綜爲南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: " On day yihai, former Chancellor Xie Tiao was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, Chancellor of State, and Guard General; Pacification Army General Shen Yue was made Right Grandee for Splendid Merit; Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made South Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: " On day yihai, former chancellor Xie Tiao was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, Chancellor of State, and Guard General; Pacification Army General Shen Yue became Right Grandee for Splendid Merit; and Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made South Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以尚書左僕射王瑩爲護軍將軍，僕射如故。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Ying was made Protector General, retaining his vice director title.
translations.idiomatic: On day dingchou, Left Vice Director Wang Ying was made Protector General while keeping his vice directorship.

sentences.zh: 甲申，立皇子綱爲晉安郡王。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the prince Gang was established as Prince of Jin'an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On day jiashen, Prince Gang was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin'an commandery.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On day dinghai, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，乙太常張充爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second month, on day gengxu, Grand Master of Ceremonies Zhang Chong was appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day gengxu, Grand Master of Ceremonies Zhang Chong was made Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day bingyin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, first day bingyin, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，魏宣武帝從弟翼率其諸弟來降。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Wei Emperor Xuanwu's cousin Yi led his brothers to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On day guiwei, Yi, cousin to Wei Emperor Xuanwu, came over with his brothers.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍劉思效破魏青州刺史元系于膠水。

translations.literal: Auxiliary State General Liu Sixiao defeated Wei Qingzhou Inspector Yuan Xi at the Jiao River.
translations.idiomatic: Auxiliary State General Liu Sixiao routed Wei Qingzhou inspector Yuan Xi on the Jiao River.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，陳伯之自壽陽率衆歸降。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Chen Bozhi from Shouyang led his forces to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On day dinghai, Chen Bozhi marched out of Shouyang with his troops and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，廬陵高昌之仁山獲銅劍二，始豊縣獲八目龜一。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on day bingshen, two bronze swords were obtained at Renshan in Gaochang, Luling; one eight-eyed turtle was obtained at Shifeng county.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, day bingshen, two bronze swords were found at Renshan in Luling's Gaochang, and an eight-eyed turtle at Shifeng county.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔曰：「朕昧旦齋居，惟刑是恤，三辟五聽，寢興載懷。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, an edict said: "I rise at dawn and dwell in abstinence; punishment alone is my concern—three verdicts and five hearings, whether waking or sleeping always on my mind.
translations.idiomatic: On day jiayin, an edict said, "I rise before dawn and keep myself in restraint; the law alone weighs on me—three reviews, five hearings, whether I sleep or wake I cannot put it aside.

sentences.zh: 故陳肺石於都街，增官司於詔獄，殷勤親覽，小大以情。

translations.literal: Therefore the lung-stone was set up in the capital streets and offices were added at the imperial prison; with earnest diligence I personally review—small and great according to circumstance.
translations.idiomatic: For this I set the grievance stone in the capital streets and added officers at the imperial prison, reviewing cases myself with care, weighing small and great alike.

sentences.zh: 而明慎未洽，囹圄尚壅，永言納隍，在予興愧。

translations.literal: Yet clarity and caution have not fully reached; prisons still clog—I ever speak of falling into the moat, and for this I feel shame.
translations.idiomatic: Yet judgment is not yet clear enough, and the jails remain choked. I speak of drowning in the ditch, and the shame is mine.

sentences.zh: 凡犴獄之所，可遣法官近侍，遞錄囚徒，如有枉滯，以時奏聞。」

translations.literal: All jail-houses may send judicial officers and close attendants in rotation to record prisoners; if there is wrongful detention, report it in timely fashion."
translations.idiomatic: Let every prison send judicial officers and close attendants in turn to record the prisoners; where anyone is held unjustly, report it at once."

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，太子左衛率張惠紹克魏宿預城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day xinwei, Left Guard of the Crown Prince Zhang Huishao captured Wei Suzhou city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on day xinwei, Left Guard of the Crown Prince Zhang Huishao took Wei Suzhou city.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，臨川王宏前軍克梁城。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Prince of Linchuan Hong's vanguard captured Liang city.
translations.idiomatic: On day yihai, Prince of Linchuan Hong's vanguard took Liang city.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，豫州刺史韋叡克合肥城。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Yuzhou Inspector Wei Rui captured Hefei city.
translations.idiomatic: On day xinsi, Yuzhou inspector Wei Rui took Hefei.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，廬江太守裴邃克羊石城；

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Lujiang Administrator Pei Sui captured Yangshi city;
translations.idiomatic: On day dinghai, Lujiang administrator Pei Sui took Yangshi city;

sentences.zh: 庚寅，又克霍丘城。

translations.literal: on day gengyin, he also captured Huoqiu city.
translations.idiomatic: on day gengyin, he took Huoqiu as well.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On day xinmao, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，青、冀二州刺史桓和前軍克朐山城。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day gengzi, Qing and Ji Inspectors Huan He's vanguard captured Qushan city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on day gengzi, the vanguard of Qing and Ji inspector Huan He took Qushan city.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，鄧至國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on day yichou, the kingdom of Dengzhi sent envoys offering local products.
