translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, day yichou, Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day wuxu, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on day wuxu, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，作太子宮。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Crown Prince's palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On day xinyou, work on the Crown Prince's palace was completed.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲子，京師地震。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on day jiazi, the capital shook with earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, eleventh month, day jiazi, the capital was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以師出淹時，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On day yichou, because the campaign had dragged on, a great pardon was granted the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On day yichou, because the armies had been in the field so long, the realm received a great pardon.

sentences.zh: 魏寇鐘離，遣右衛將軍曹景宗率衆赴援。

translations.literal: Wei raided Zhongli; Right Guard General Cao Jingzong was sent to lead troops to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei struck Zhongli, Right Guard General Cao Jingzong was sent with troops to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，司徒謝朏薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on day guimao, Chancellor of State Xie Tiao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on day guimao, Chancellor of State Xie Tiao died.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛酉朔，詔曰：「徑寸之寶，或隱沙泥；

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the first day xinyou, an edict said: "A gem an inch across may lie hidden in sand and mud;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, spring, first month, first day xinyou, an edict said, "A gem no larger than an inch may lie buried in sand and mud;

sentences.zh: 以人廢言，君子斯戒。

translations.literal: to dismiss words because of the speaker—the gentleman takes this as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: and to reject a man's words because of the man himself is what the gentleman warns against.

sentences.zh: 朕聽朝晏罷，思闡政術，雖百辟卿士，有懷必聞，而蓄響邊遐，未臻魏闕。

translations.literal: I listen to court until evening dismissal, thinking to clarify governance; though the hundred ministers and grandees—all who have thoughts I hear—yet voices stored in border and remote lands have not reached the Wei gate.
translations.idiomatic: I hold court until evening, seeking to sharpen my rule; though the hundred ministers and grandees may speak their minds to me, voices held back in distant borders still never reach the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 或屈以貧陋，或間以山川，頓足延首，無因奏達。

translations.literal: Some are constrained by poverty and low standing, some separated by mountains and rivers; they stamp their feet and stretch their necks but have no means to present and reach.
translations.idiomatic: Some are held down by poverty and low birth, others cut off by mountains and rivers; they stamp their feet and crane their necks, yet have no way to bring their words before me.

sentences.zh: 豈所以沉浮靡漏，遠邇兼得者乎？

translations.literal: How is this the way to float and sink without leakage, near and far both obtained?
translations.idiomatic: How can the realm be governed so that nothing is lost between near and far, high and low?

sentences.zh: 四方士民，若有欲陳言刑政，益國利民，淪礙幽遠，不能自通者，可各詮條布懷于刺史二千石。

translations.literal: Scholars and commoners of the four directions—if any wish to speak on punishment and government, benefit the state and benefit the people, submerged and blocked in remote depths and cannot reach on their own—may each set forth their proposals and lay their hearts before the inspectors and the two-thousand-bushel officials.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars and commoners everywhere who wish to speak on law and government, on what would benefit the state and the people, yet are buried in remote places and cannot reach me themselves, may lay out their proposals before the inspectors and the two-thousand-bushel officials.

sentences.zh: 有可申采，大小以聞。

translations.literal: What can be reported for selection—small and great let it be heard."
translations.idiomatic: Whatever deserves attention, great or small, let it be brought to my hearing."

sentences.zh: 」己卯，詔曰：「夫有天下者，義非爲己。

translations.literal: On day jimao, an edict said: "He who possesses the realm—righteousness is not for himself.
translations.idiomatic: On day jimao, an edict said, "Whoever holds the realm does not hold it for himself alone.

sentences.zh: 凶荒疾癘，兵革水火，有一於此，責歸元首。

translations.literal: Famine, pestilence, weapons, fire and water—if one of these exists, blame returns to the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: Famine, plague, war, fire, or flood—where one of these strikes, the fault lies with the ruler.

sentences.zh: 今祝史請禱，繼諸不善，以朕身當之。

translations.literal: Now the prayer masters request supplication, transferring all ill fortune—let my person bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Now the prayer masters ask to offer sacrifice and shift every ill upon another; let it fall on me instead.

sentences.zh: 永使災害不及萬姓，俾茲下民稍蒙寧息。

translations.literal: Ever may calamity not reach the myriad people; may these lower people gradually receive peace and rest.
translations.idiomatic: May disaster never touch the myriad people; may those below me little by little know peace.

sentences.zh: 不得爲朕祈福，以增其過。

translations.literal: Do not pray blessings for me, thereby adding to my fault.
translations.idiomatic: Do not pray for my sake and thereby deepen my guilt.

sentences.zh: 特班遠邇，咸令遵奉。」

translations.literal: Specially promulgated near and far—all are ordered to obey."
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed everywhere, near and far, and obeyed as law."

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the second month, on day jiachen, the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on day jiachen, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申朔，隕霜殺草。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day gengshen, falling frost killed the grass.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, first day gengshen, frost fell and killed the grass.

sentences.zh: 是月，有三象入京師。

translations.literal: That month, three elephants entered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month three elephants entered the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，置左右驍騎、左右遊擊將軍官。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on day renchen, the posts of Left and Right Valiant Cavalry General and Left and Right Mobile Strike General were established.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, day renchen, the court established the posts of Left and Right Valiant Cavalry General and Left and Right Mobile Strike General.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，曹景宗、韋叡等破魏軍於邵陽洲，斬獲萬計。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Cao Jingzong, Wei Rui, and others defeated the Wei army at Shaoyang Isle; those slain and captured numbered ten thousand and more.
translations.idiomatic: On day guisi, Cao Jingzong, Wei Rui, and the rest routed the Wei army at Shaoyang Isle, killing and capturing more than ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以右衛將軍曹景宗爲領軍將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Right Guard General Cao Jingzong was made Commander-in-Chief and Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On day guimao, Right Guard General Cao Jingzong was made Commander-in-Chief and Xuzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以江州刺史王茂爲尚書右僕射，中書令安成王秀爲平南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Jiangzhou Inspector Wang Mao was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Supervisor of the Secretariat Prince of Ancheng Xiu was made General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On day jiyou, Jiangzhou inspector Wang Mao was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Supervisor of the Secretariat Prince of Ancheng Xiu was made General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 分湘廣二州置衡州。

translations.literal: Heng province was established by dividing Xiang and Guang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Heng province was created from parts of Xiang and Guang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史臨川王宏爲驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司，撫軍將軍建安王偉爲揚州刺史，右光祿大夫沈約爲尚書左僕射，尚書左僕射王瑩爲中軍將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Central Army General and Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Rapid Cavalry General with open office equal-to-three-division protocol; Pacification Army General Prince of Jian'an Wei was made Yangzhou Inspector; Right Grandee for Splendid Merit Shen Yue was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Left Vice Director Wang Ying was made Central Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On day dingsi, Central Army General and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Rapid Cavalry General with open office equal-to-three-division protocol; Pacification Army General Prince of Jian'an Wei became Yangzhou inspector; Right Grandee for Splendid Merit Shen Yue became Left Vice Director; and Left Vice Director Wang Ying was made Central Army General.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，以新除左驍騎將軍長沙王深業爲中護軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day jiwei, newly appointed Left Valiant Cavalry General Prince of Changsha Shenye was made Central Protector General.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on day jiwei, newly appointed Left Valiant Cavalry General Prince of Changsha Shenye was made Central Protector General.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以侍中袁昂爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Palace Attendant Yuan Ang was made Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On day guihai, Palace Attendant Yuan Ang was appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置中衛、中權將軍，改驍騎爲雲騎，遊擊爲遊騎。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Central Guard and Central Power generals were established; Valiant Cavalry was changed to Cloud Cavalry, Mobile Strike to Mobile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On day jisi, the posts of Central Guard General and Central Power General were created; Valiant Cavalry was renamed Cloud Cavalry, and Mobile Strike was renamed Mobile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 辛未，右將軍、揚州刺史建安王偉進號中權將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Right General and Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Jian'an Wei was promoted to Central Power General.
translations.idiomatic: On day xinwei, Right General and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Jian'an Wei was advanced to Central Power General.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，以車騎將軍、湘州刺史夏侯詳爲右光祿大夫，新除金紫光祿大夫柳惔爲安南將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day gengxu, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Xiangzhou Inspector Xiahou Xiang was made Right Grandee for Splendid Merit; newly appointed Grandee for Splendid Merit with the Golden Seal and Purple Tassel Liu Yan was made General Who Pacifies the South and Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on day gengxu, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Xiangzhou inspector Xiahou Xiang was made Right Grandee for Splendid Merit, and newly appointed Grandee for Splendid Merit with the Golden Seal and Purple Tassel Liu Yan was made General Who Pacifies the South and Xiangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 新吳縣獲四目龜一。

translations.literal: One four-eyed turtle was obtained in Xinwu county.
translations.idiomatic: A four-eyed turtle was found in Xinwu county.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on day jiazi, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, day jiazi, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，分廣州置桂州。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Gui province was established by dividing Guang province.
translations.idiomatic: On day bingyin, Gui province was carved out of Guang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以新除尚書右僕射王茂爲中衛將軍。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, newly appointed Right Vice Director Wang Mao was made Central Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: On day dinghai, newly appointed Right Vice Director Wang Mao was made Central Guard General.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，赦天下。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day wuzi, the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on day wuzi, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大風折木。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, a great wind snapped trees.
translations.idiomatic: On day wuxu, a fierce wind broke trees.

sentences.zh: 京師大水，因濤入，加御道七尺。

translations.literal: The capital suffered great flood; water came in with the tidal bore, raising the imperial road by seven chi.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was flooded; the tide drove water inland and lifted the imperial road seven chi.

sentences.zh: 九月，嘉禾一莖九穗，生江陵縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, auspicious grain with one stalk and nine ears grew in Jiangling county.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Jiangling county produced auspicious grain: one stalk with nine ears.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，改閱武堂爲德陽堂，聽訟堂爲儀賢堂。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Review-of-Troops Hall was renamed Virtue-and-Yang Hall, and the Court-for-Hearing-Litigation Hall was renamed Hall of Esteeming Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On day yihai, the Review-of-Troops Hall became Virtue-and-Yang Hall, and the Court-for-Hearing-Litigation Hall became the Hall of Esteeming Worthies.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以左衛將軍呂僧珍爲平北將軍、南兗州刺史，豫章內史蕭昌爲廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Left Guard General Lü Sengzhen was made General Who Pacifies the North and South Yanzhou Inspector; Interior Secretary of Yuzhang Xiao Chang was made Guangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On day bingxu, Left Guard General Lü Sengzhen was made General Who Pacifies the North and South Yanzhou inspector, and Interior Secretary of Yuzhang Xiao Chang was made Guangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，以五兵尚書徐勉爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on day renyin, Director of the Five Weapons Xu Mian was made Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, day renyin, Director of the Five Weapons Xu Mian was appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙丑，以驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司臨川王宏爲司徒、行太子太傅，尚書左僕射沈約爲尚書令、行太子少傅，吏部尚書袁昂爲右僕射。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on day yichou, Rapid Cavalry General with open office equal-to-three-division protocol Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Chancellor of State and Acting Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; Left Vice Director Shen Yue was made Director of the Masters of Writing and Acting Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yuan Ang was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on day yichou, Rapid Cavalry General with open office equal-to-three-division protocol Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Chancellor of State and Acting Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; Left Vice Director Shen Yue became Director of the Masters of Writing and Acting Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; and Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yuan Ang became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，平西將軍、荊州刺史始興王憺進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, General Who Quells the West and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Dan was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On day wuyin, General Who Quells the West and Jingzhou inspector Prince of Shixing Dan was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以右光祿大夫夏侯詳爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Right Grandee for Splendid Merit Xiahou Xiang was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On day jiashen, Right Grandee for Splendid Merit Xiahou Xiang was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，尚書左僕射夏侯詳卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on day bingchen, Left Vice Director Xiahou Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on day bingchen, Left Vice Director Xiahou Xiang died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，魏淮陽鎮都軍主常邕和以城內屬。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Wei Huaiyang Garrison Commander-in-Chief Chang Yinhe surrendered the city to us.
translations.idiomatic: On day yichou, Wei Huaiyang garrison commander Chang Yinhe surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 分豫州置霍州。

translations.literal: Huo province was established by dividing Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huo province was created from parts of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月乙酉朔，詔曰：「建國君民，立教爲首。

translations.literal: In spring of the seventh year, first month, day yiyou new moon, an edict said: "To establish a state and govern the people, establishing education comes first.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the yiyou new moon of the first month, an edict declared: "To found a realm and rule the people, instruction must come first.

sentences.zh: 不學將落，嘉植靡由。

translations.literal: Without learning one will decline; fine talent has no source.
translations.idiomatic: Without study the state withers, and worthy minds have nowhere to grow.

sentences.zh: 朕肇基明命，光宅區宇，雖耕耘雅業，傍闡藝文，而成器未廣，志本猶闕，非所以鎔範貴游，納諸軌度。

translations.literal: I have received the bright mandate and settled the realm; though I have cultivated elegant pursuits and promoted arts and letters, those fully formed remain few and my fundamental aim is still lacking—not the way to mold the nobility and bring them into proper measure.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate has settled me in this land; I have worked the fields of culture and opened the gates of learning, yet too few are fully shaped and my deepest purpose remains unfinished—not enough to forge the high-born and guide them into order.

sentences.zh: 思欲式敦讓齒，自家刑國。

translations.literal: I wish to honor yielding to elders and govern the state as I would my own household.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to teach reverence for age and to rule the realm as one rules a household.

sentences.zh: 今聲訓所漸，戎夏同風，宜大啓庠斅，博延胄子，務彼十倫，弘此三德，使陶鈞遠被，微言載表。

translations.literal: Now voice and instruction have spread everywhere, barbarian and Chinese share the same wind; it is fitting to open schools broadly, extend welcome to noble scions, attend to the ten human relations, expand the three virtues, so that the transforming pot reaches far and subtle teachings are displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Instruction now reaches every quarter, and north and south breathe the same air. Schools should open wide, sons of noble houses should be gathered in, the ten bonds of humanity honored, the three virtues enlarged, until the potter's wheel of transformation reaches far and the subtle word is made manifest.

sentences.zh: 」中衛將軍、領太子詹事王茂進號車騎將軍。

translations.literal: " Central Guard General and concurrent Crown Prince Household Steward Wang Mao was promoted to Chariots and Cavalry General.
translations.idiomatic: " Central Guard General Wang Mao, who also served as Crown Prince Household Steward, was promoted to Chariots and Cavalry General.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，作神龍、仁虎闕於端門、大司馬門外。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Divine Dragon and Benevolent Tiger towers were built outside the End Gate and Grand Marshal Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Divine Dragon and Benevolent Tiger towers were raised outside the End Gate and the Grand Marshal Gate.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以領軍將軍曹景宗爲中衛將軍，衛尉蕭景兼領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Commandant-of-the-Guard General Cao Jingzong was made Central Guard General; Court Commandant Xiao Jing was additionally made Commandant-of-the-Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Cao Jingzong, Commandant-of-the-Guard, became Central Guard General; Court Commandant Xiao Jing was also made Commandant-of-the-Guard.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，廬江灊縣獲銅鐘二。

translations.literal: Second month, day yimao: two bronze bells were found in Zhan county, Lujiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao day, two bronze bells were discovered in Zhan county, Lujiang.

sentences.zh: 新作國門于越城南。

translations.literal: A new state gate was built south of Yue city.
translations.idiomatic: A new state gate was constructed south of Yue city.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，增置鎮衛將軍以下各有差。

translations.literal: Day yichou: added posts of Garrison-Guard General and below, each with its rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the offices from Garrison-Guard General downward were expanded, each at its proper rank.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔於州郡縣置州望、郡宗、鄉豪各一人，專掌搜薦。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict established one Provincial Notable, one District Patriarch, and one Village Magnate in each province, commandery, and county, charged exclusively with search and recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, an edict ordered that each province, commandery, and county appoint one Provincial Notable, one District Patriarch, and one Village Magnate, each charged solely with seeking out and recommending talent.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以車騎大將軍高麗王高雲爲撫東大將軍、開府儀同三司，平北將軍、南兗州刺史呂僧珍爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Chariots and Cavalry Grand General, King of Gaoli Gao Yun was made General Who Pacifies the East, with the Grand General's Open Office and Third-Rank Ceremonial Parity; General Who Pacifies the North and South Yanzhou Inspector Lu Sengzhen was made Commandant-of-the-Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Gao Yun, King of Gaoli and Chariots and Cavalry Grand General, was made General Who Pacifies the East with an open office and third-rank ceremonial parity; Lu Sengzhen, General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of South Yanzhou, became Commandant-of-the-Guard.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以中護軍長沙王深業爲南兗州刺史，兼領軍將軍蕭景爲雍州刺史，雍州刺史柳慶遠爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Central Guard Army Changsha Prince Shen Ye was made South Yanzhou Inspector; concurrent Commandant Xiao Jing was made Yongzhou Inspector; Yongzhou Inspector Liu Qingyuan was made Guard Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Changsha Prince Shen Ye, Central Guard Army, was made inspector of South Yanzhou; Xiao Jing, who also held the commandant's post, became inspector of Yongzhou; and Liu Qingyuan, inspector of Yongzhou, was made Guard Army General.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，皇太子納妃，赦大辟以下，頒賜朝臣及近侍各有差。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day yimao: the Crown Prince took a consort; pardoned crimes below capital offense; distributed gifts to court ministers and close attendants each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao day, the Crown Prince took a consort; crimes short of capital punishment were pardoned; and court ministers and close attendants received gifts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 辛未，秣陵縣獲靈龜一。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: one spirit turtle was found in Moling county.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, a spirit turtle was found in Moling county.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，餘姚縣獲古銅劍二。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: two ancient bronze swords were found in Yuyao county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, two ancient bronze swords were discovered in Yuyao county.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，詔復置宗正、太僕、大匠、鴻臚，又增太府、太舟，仍先爲十二卿。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jihai: an edict restored Director of the Imperial Clan, Grand Master of Stud, Grand Master for Construction, and Grand Master of Ceremonies; also added Grand Storehouse and Grand Master of River Transport—twelve directorates as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai day, an edict restored the Director of the Imperial Clan, Grand Master of Stud, Grand Master for Construction, and Grand Master of Ceremonies, and added the Grand Storehouse and Grand Master of River Transport, returning to the former twelve directorates.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以平南將軍、江州刺史安成王秀爲平西將軍、荊州刺史，安西將軍、荊州刺史始興王憺爲護軍將軍，中衛將軍曹景宗爲安南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Day guimao: General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou Inspector Prince of Ancheng Xiu was made General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou Inspector; General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Dan was made Guard Army General; Central Guard General Cao Jingzong was made General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou, became General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou; Prince of Shixing Dan, General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou, was made Guard Army General; and Cao Jingzong, Central Guard General, became General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，復建、修二陵周回五里內居民，改陵監爲令。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou: restored residents within five li around the Jian and Xiu mausoleums; changed tomb supervisors to magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinyou day, residents within five li of the Jian and Xiu tombs were restored to their lands, and tomb supervisors were renamed magistrates.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，月犯氐。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day dinghai: the moon crossed the constellation Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai day, the moon entered the constellation Di.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，安南將軍、江州刺史曹景宗卒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guichou: General Who Pacifies the South and Jiangzhou Inspector Cao Jingzong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou day, Cao Jingzong, General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，赦大辟以下未結正者。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: pardoned capital offenses and below for cases not yet concluded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, capital crimes and lesser offenses in unresolved cases were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，平西將軍、荊州刺史安成王秀進號安西將軍，雲麾將軍、郢州刺史鄱陽王恢進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Ancheng Xiu was promoted to General Who Secures the West; Cloud-Banner General and Yingzhou Inspector Prince of Poyang Hui was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou, was promoted to General Who Secures the West; and Prince of Poyang Hui, Cloud-Banner General and inspector of Yingzhou, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 老人星見。

translations.literal: The Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: The Old Man star was seen.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，詔曰：「芻牧必往，姬文垂則，雉兔有刑，姜宣致貶。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dinghai, an edict said: "Pasturing fodder must go forth—King Wen of Zhou left the rule; pheasant and hare had punishments—Jiang Xuan brought condemnation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai day, an edict said: "Fodder must be gathered from the wild—King Wen of Zhou left us that rule; even pheasant and hare were subject to law—Jiang Xuan was rebuked for forgetting it.

sentences.zh: 藪澤山林，毓材是出，斧斤之用，比屋所資。

translations.literal: Marshes, lakes, mountains, and forests—materials are born there; axe and adze are needed in every household.
translations.idiomatic: From marsh, lake, hill, and forest come the materials every household needs for axe and adze.

sentences.zh: 而頃世相承，並加封固，豈所謂與民同利，惠茲黔首？

translations.literal: Yet in recent generations this has been inherited and all has been sealed and barred—is this what is called sharing profit with the people, benefiting the common folk?
translations.idiomatic: Yet in recent times these lands have been sealed and fenced off, generation after generation—is that sharing profit with the people, or showing mercy to the common folk?

sentences.zh: 凡公家諸屯戍見封熂者，可悉開常禁。

translations.literal: All government garrisons and posts that have been sealed and burned over—open the usual prohibitions entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever government garrisons and posts have been sealed or cleared by fire, the ordinary prohibitions should now be lifted entirely.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，置童子奉車郎。

translations.literal: " Day renchen: established Gentlemen Attendants of the Boy Cartbearers.
translations.idiomatic: " On renchen day, the office of Gentlemen Attendants of the Boy Cartbearers was established.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立皇子績爲南康郡王。

translations.literal: Day guisi: established the prince Ji as Prince of Nankang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Prince Ji was enfeoffed as Prince of Nankang commandery.

sentences.zh: 己亥，月犯東井。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the moon crossed the Eastern Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the moon entered the Eastern Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，以吳興太守張稷爲尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day bingyin: Wuxing Administrator Zhang Ji was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingyin day, Zhang Ji, administrator of Wuxing, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丙子，魏陽關主許敬珍以城內附。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Wei Yang Pass commander Xu Jingzhen surrendered the city to us.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Xu Jingzhen, commander of Wei's Yang Pass, surrendered his city to the court.

sentences.zh: 詔大舉北伐。

translations.literal: An edict ordered a great northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for a major northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 以護軍將軍始興王憺爲平北將軍，率衆入清；

translations.literal: Guard Army General Prince of Shixing Dan was made General Who Pacifies the North, leading troops into Qing;
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Shixing Dan, Guard Army General, was made General Who Pacifies the North and led an army into Qing;

sentences.zh: 車騎將軍王茂率衆向宿預。

translations.literal: Chariots and Cavalry General Wang Mao led troops toward Suyu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mao, Chariots and Cavalry General, led troops toward Suyu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，魏懸瓠鎮軍主白皁生、豫州刺史胡遜以城內屬。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Wei Xuanhu garrison commander Bai Zaosheng and Yuzhou Inspector Hu Xun surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Bai Zaosheng, garrison commander at Wei's Xuanhu, and Hu Xun, inspector of Yuzhou, surrendered their city.

sentences.zh: 以皁生爲鎮北將軍、司州刺史，遜爲平北將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Zaosheng was made General Who Garrisons the North and Sizhou Inspector; Xun was made General Who Pacifies the North and Yuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Zaosheng was made General Who Garrisons the North and inspector of Sizhou; Xun was made General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，鄞縣言甘露降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinsi: Yin county reported sweet dew fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinsi day, Yin county reported that sweet dew had fallen.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛巳，輿駕親祠南郊，赦天下，內外文武各賜勞一年。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, day xinsi: the Emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Altar, amnestied the realm, and granted one year of labor reward to civil and military officials inside and outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on xinsi day of the first month of spring, the Emperor sacrificed at the Southern Altar in person, amnestied the realm, and granted one year's labor reward to civil and military officials within and beyond the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，魏鎮東參軍成景儁斬宿預城主嚴仲寶，以城內屬。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Wei East Garrison aide Cheng Jingjun beheaded Suyu city commander Yan Zhongbao and surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Cheng Jingjun, aide of Wei's East Garrison, beheaded Yan Zhongbao, commander of Suyu, and surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，老人星見。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu day, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，以北巴西郡置南梁州。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: established South Liangzhou from northern Ba-West Brazil commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, South Liangzhou was established from the northern part of Ba-West Brazil commandery.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以護軍將軍始興王憺爲中衛將軍，司徒、行太子太傅臨川王宏爲司空、揚州刺史，車騎將軍、領太子詹事王茂卽本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Guard Army General Prince of Shixing Dan was made Central Guard General; Minister of Education, acting Crown Prince Grand Tutor Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Minister of Works and Yangzhou Inspector; Chariots and Cavalry General and Crown Prince Steward Wang Mao received Open Office at Third-Rank Ceremonial Parity under his original title.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Prince of Shixing Dan, Guard Army General, became Central Guard General; Prince of Linchuan Hong, Minister of Education and acting Crown Prince Grand Tutor, was made Minister of Works and inspector of Yangzhou; and Wang Mao, Chariots and Cavalry General and Crown Prince Steward, received an open office with third-rank ceremonial parity under his existing title.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，魏楚王城主李國興以城內附。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Wei King of Chu city commander Li Guoxing surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Li Guoxing, commander of Wei's King of Chu city, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以中軍將軍、丹陽尹王瑩爲右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Central Army General and Danyang Intendant Wang Ying was made Right Grand Master for Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Wang Ying, Central Army General and intendant of Danyang, was made Right Grand Master for Splendor.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，詔曰：「學以從政，殷勤往哲，祿在其中，抑亦前事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renwu, an edict said: "Learning for government—earnest sages of old, salary therein—is also a matter of precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renwu day, an edict said: "The ancients taught that learning serves government, and that reward belongs to the learned—this too is an old truth.

sentences.zh: 朕思闡治綱，每敦儒術，軾閭辟館，造次以之。

translations.literal: I think to clarify governance, always encouraging Confucian arts, opening halls at carriage doors—in haste with this.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to set the lines of rule in order and honor the Confucian way, opening halls even at the carriage gate and pressing forward without delay.

sentences.zh: 故負袟成風，甲科間出，方當置諸周行，飾以青紫。

translations.literal: Hence carrying books became custom, top graduates emerged one after another—they should be placed in court ranks, adorned with blue and purple.
translations.idiomatic: Books are carried everywhere now, and top graduates appear in steady succession; they should be placed in court service and adorned with blue and purple.

sentences.zh: 其有能通一經，始末無倦者，策實之後，選可量加敘錄。

translations.literal: Those who can master one classic, from start to finish without weariness—after written examination confirming merit, selection may add promotions according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever can master one classic from beginning to end without slackening, once tested and found worthy, may be promoted according to merit.

sentences.zh: 雖復牛監羊肆，寒品後門，並隨才試吏，勿有遺隔。」

translations.literal: Even ox-keepers and mutton shops, humble origins at the back door—test all according to talent for office; let none be left out."
translations.idiomatic: Even ox-keepers and mutton sellers, men of humble birth from the back door—all should be tried for office according to talent, and none passed over."

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，巴陵王蕭寶義薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day guisi: Prince of Baling Xiao Baoyi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guisi day, Prince of Baling Xiao Baoyi died.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，老人星見。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuwu: the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuwu day, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，以中軍將軍始興王慎爲鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史，南兗州刺史長沙王深業爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day yisi: Central Army General Prince of Shixing Dan was made General Who Garrisons the North and South Yanzhou Inspector; South Yanzhou Inspector Changsha Prince Shen Ye was made Guard Army General.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yisi day, Prince of Shixing Dan, Central Army General, was made General Who Garrisons the North and inspector of South Yanzhou; and Changsha Prince Shen Ye, inspector of South Yanzhou, was made Guard Army General.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月乙亥，以尚書令、行太子少傅沈約爲左光祿大夫，行少傅如故，右光祿大夫王瑩爲尚書令，行中撫將軍建安王偉領護軍將軍，鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史始興王憺爲鎮西將軍、益州刺史，太常卿王亮爲中書監。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, day yihai: Masters of Writing Director and acting Crown Prince Junior Tutor Shen Yue was made Left Grand Master for Splendor, retaining the acting junior tutorship; Right Grand Master for Splendor Wang Ying was made Masters of Writing Director; acting Central Pacification General Prince of Jian'an Wei was made concurrent Guard Army General; General Who Garrisons the North and South Yanzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Dan was made General Who Garrisons the West and Yizhou Inspector; Grand Master of Ceremonies Wang Liang was made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on yihai day of the first month of spring, Shen Yue, Masters of Writing Director and acting Crown Prince Junior Tutor, was made Left Grand Master for Splendor while keeping the junior tutorship; Wang Ying, Right Grand Master for Splendor, became Masters of Writing Director; Prince of Jian'an Wei, acting Central Pacification General, was made concurrent Guard Army General; Prince of Shixing Dan, General Who Garrisons the North and inspector of South Yanzhou, was made General Who Garrisons the West and inspector of Yizhou; and Wang Liang, Grand Master of Ceremonies, was made Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以輕車將軍晉安王綱爲南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Light Chariots General Prince of Jin'an Gang was made South Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Prince of Jin'an Gang, Light Chariots General, was made inspector of South Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，新作緣淮塘，北岸起石頭迄東冶，南岸起後渚籬門迄三橋。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: newly built Huai embankment works, north bank from Stone Fort to East Smeltery, south bank from Rear Islet Hedge Gate to Three Bridges.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, new embankments along the Huai were built, the north bank running from Stone Fort to East Smeltery and the south bank from Rear Islet Hedge Gate to Three Bridges.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，車駕幸國子學，親臨講肆，賜國子祭酒以下帛各有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, personally attended the lecture hall, and granted silk to the Academy Rector and below each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou day, the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, attended the lecture hall in person, and granted silk to the Academy Rector and those below him according to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔曰：「王子從學，著自禮經，貴遊咸在，實惟前誥，所以式廣義方，克隆教道。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, an edict said: "Princes following study is established in the Book of Rites; noble scions all included is truly former instruction; thus to expand righteous conduct and duplicate the teaching way.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, an edict said: "That princes should follow teachers is written in the Book of Rites; that noble youths should all be included is an instruction of old; by this we broaden righteous conduct and carry forward the way of teaching.

sentences.zh: 今成均大啓，元良齒讓，自斯以降，並宜肄業。

translations.literal: Now the Academy grandly opens, the crown prince yields by age—from this down, all should pursue study.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Academy opens wide, and the crown prince yields place by age; from this time forward, all should apply themselves to learning.

sentences.zh: 皇太子及王侯之子，年在從師者，可令入學。

translations.literal: The Crown Prince and sons of princes and marquises, of age to follow teachers, may be ordered to enter school.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince and the sons of princes and marquises who have reached the age for teachers should be sent to enter the schools.

sentences.zh: 」于闐國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: " Khotan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: " Khotan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，革選尚書五都令史用寒流。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day dingsi: reformed selection of Masters of Writing Five Capital clerks to use humble-stream candidates.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi day, selection for the Five Capital clerks of the Masters of Writing was reformed to draw from humble-stream candidates.

sentences.zh: 林邑國遣使獻白猴一。

translations.literal: Linyi sent envoys presenting one white monkey.
translations.idiomatic: Linyi sent envoys bearing one white monkey.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，詔曰：「朕達聽思治，無忘日昃。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jihai, an edict said: "I listen broadly and think on governance, never forgetting the slanting sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai day, an edict said: "I listen widely and think constantly on rule, never forgetting the sun already past noon.

sentences.zh: 而百司羣務，其途不一，隨時適用，各有攸宜，若非總會衆言，無以備茲親覽。

translations.literal: Yet the hundred offices and many affairs—their paths are not one; applied as times suit, each has its fit—unless gathering all opinions, there is no way to prepare this for my personal review.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the hundred offices and their many tasks follow more than one path; each matter has its proper season and use, and unless all voices are gathered together, I cannot review them as I should.

sentences.zh: 自今臺閣省府州郡鎮戍應有職僚之所，時共集議，各陳損益，具以奏聞。

translations.literal: From now wherever bureaus of the Secretariat, ministries, provinces, commanderies, and garrison posts have responsible officials—meet regularly to discuss, each state benefits and harms, and fully memorial for report.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, at every bureau of the Secretariat, ministry, province, commandery, and garrison post where responsible officials serve, they should meet at intervals to discuss together, each stating gains and losses, and report the whole in memorial.

sentences.zh: 」中書監王亮卒。

translations.literal: " Director of the Secretariat Wang Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Liang, Director of the Secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，盜殺宣城太守朱僧勇。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guichou: bandits killed Xuancheng Administrator Zhu Sengyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guichou day, bandits killed Zhu Sengyong, administrator of Xuancheng.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以中撫將軍、領護軍建安王偉爲鎮南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Central Pacification General, concurrent Guard Army Prince of Jian'an Wei was made General Who Garrisons the South and Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Prince of Jian'an Wei, Central Pacification General and concurrent Guard Army, was made General Who Garrisons the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 閏月己丑，宣城盜轉寇吳興縣，太守蔡撙討平之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jichou: Xuancheng bandits turned to raid Wuxing county; Administrator Cai Bun suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jichou day, Xuancheng bandits turned to raid Wuxing county; Cai Bun, the administrator, suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，老人星見。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jisi: the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi day, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月癸未，輿駕幸國子學，策試胄子，賜訓授之司各有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month of winter, day guiwei: the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, tested noble scions by examination, and granted rewards to the instructing offices each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on guiwei day, the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, tested the noble scions by examination, and granted rewards to the teaching offices according to rank.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月辛丑，輿駕親祠南郊，大赦天下，居局治事賜勞二年。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, day xinchou: the Emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Altar, granted a great amnesty, and those staying at their posts received two years of labor reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on xinchou day of the first month of spring, the Emperor sacrificed at the Southern Altar in person, amnestied the realm, and granted two years' labor reward to officials remaining at their posts.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以尚書左僕射張稷爲安北將軍，青冀二州刺史，郢州刺史鄱陽王恢爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Zhang Ji was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces; Yingzhou Inspector Prince of Poyang Hui was made Guard Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Zhang Ji, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of Qing and Ji provinces; and Prince of Poyang Hui, inspector of Yingzhou, was made Guard Army General.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以南徐州刺史豫章王綜爲郢州刺史，輕車將軍南康王績爲南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: South Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made Yingzhou Inspector; Light Chariots General Prince of Nankang Ji was made South Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Prince of Yuzhang Zong, inspector of South Xuzhou, became inspector of Yingzhou; and Prince of Nankang Ji, Light Chariots General, was made inspector of South Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，騶虞一，見荊州華容縣。

translations.literal: Day wushen: one zouyu appeared in Huarong county, Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, a zouyu was seen in Huarong county, Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以左民尚書王暕爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Left People Minister Wang Yan was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan, Left People Minister, was made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，輿駕親祠明堂。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Emperor personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Emperor sacrificed at the Bright Hall in person.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，盜殺東莞、琅邪二郡太守鄧晣，以朐山引魏軍，遣振遠將軍馬仙琕討之。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: bandits killed Dongguan and Langye commanderies' Administrator Deng Ti; using Qushan they drew in the Wei army, and Quake-Distant General Ma Xiancai was sent to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinchou day, bandits killed Deng Ti, administrator of Dongguan and Langye; they used Qushan to bring in Wei forces, and the court sent Quake-Distant General Ma Xiancai to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 是月，魏徐州刺史盧昶帥衆赴朐山。

translations.literal: That month: Wei Xuzhou Inspector Lu Chang led troops to Qushan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Lu Chang, Wei's inspector of Xuzhou, led troops to Qushan.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸酉，安豊縣獲一角玄龜。

translations.literal: Fifth month of summer, day guiyou: Anfeng county found one single-horned black turtle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on guiyou day, Anfeng county found a one-horned black turtle.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，領軍呂僧珍卒。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Commandant Lu Sengzhen died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Lu Sengzhen, Commandant-of-the-Guard, died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以國子祭酒張充爲尚書左僕射，太子詹事柳慶遠爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Academy Rector Zhang Chong was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Crown Prince Steward Liu Qingyuan was made Commandant-of-the-Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Zhang Chong, Academy Rector, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; and Liu Qingyuan, Crown Prince Steward, was made Commandant-of-the-Guard.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，嘉蓮一莖三花生樂游苑。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou: one auspicious lotus stalk with three flowers in Leyou Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou day, an auspicious lotus with one stalk and three flowers appeared in Leyou Garden.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，詔曰：「昔公卿面陳，載在前史，令僕陛奏，列代明文，所以釐彼庶績，成茲羣務。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day bingchen, an edict said: "Formerly ministers faced the throne and stated—recorded in former histories; prefects and stewards reported at the steps—clear text in successive dynasties—thus to set those many tasks in order and accomplish these group affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen day, an edict said: "In former ages ministers spoke face to face before the throne, as the old histories record; prefects and stewards memorialized from the steps, as dynast after dynast made plain—by this the many tasks were ordered and the work of state completed.

sentences.zh: 晉氏陵替，虛誕爲風，自此相因，其失彌遠。

translations.literal: The Jin dynasty declined, empty fabrication became the wind—from this inherited, the fault grew ever farther.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin fell into decay, empty pretense became the fashion, and from that inheritance the fault only widened.

sentences.zh: 遂使武帳空勞，無汲公之奏，丹墀徒辟，闕鄭生之履。

translations.literal: Thus the martial canopy labored empty—no Ji Gong's memorial; the red steps stood vacant—lacking Zheng Sheng's footprints.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the martial canopy stood idle with no memorial like Ji Gong's; the red steps lay empty with no footfall like Zheng Sheng's.

sentences.zh: 三槐八座，應有務之百官，宜有所論，可入陳啓，庶藉周爰，少匡寡薄。」

translations.literal: Three catalpas, eight seats—officials with duties—all should have something to discuss, may enter and state memorials, hoping through universal care to slightly correct my thinness."
translations.idiomatic: You who hold the three catalpas and eight seats, all officials charged with affairs, should speak when you have something to say; enter and memorial as you will, that through your broad care you may lend a little strength to my own thin worth."

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，天西北隆隆有聲，赤氣下至地。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingshen: the northwest sky rumbled, and red qi descended to earth.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen day, the northwest sky thundered, and red vapor descended to the ground.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月癸酉，山車見于臨城縣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month of winter, day guiyou: a mountain cart appeared in Lincheng county.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on guiyou day, a mountain cart was seen in Lincheng county.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，馬仙琕大破魏軍，斬馘十餘萬，剋復朐山城。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Ma Xiancai greatly defeated the Wei army, beheaded more than one hundred thousand, and recovered Qushan city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Ma Xiancai routed the Wei army, took more than one hundred thousand heads, and recovered Qushan city.

sentences.zh: 是歲，初作宮城門三重樓及開二道。

translations.literal: That year: first built triple-storied towers on palace city gates and opened two roads.
translations.idiomatic: That year, triple-storied towers were first built on the palace city gates, and two new roads were opened.

sentences.zh: 宕昌國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Dangchang sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Dangchang sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月壬辰，詔曰：「夫刑法悼耄，罪不收孥，禮著明文，史彰前事，蓋所以申其哀矜，故罰有弗及。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, day renchen, an edict said: "Punishment law pities the aged—crime does not implicate offspring—Rites has clear text, histories show former affairs—generally to extend compassion, thus punishment has what does not reach.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on renchen day of the first month of spring, an edict said: "The law of punishment shows mercy to the aged, and guilt does not fall on a man's household—the Rites state this plainly, and the histories show it in former cases—so that compassion may be extended and punishment may stop where it should.

sentences.zh: 近代相因，厥網彌峻，髫年華髮，同坐入諐。

translations.literal: Recent generations inherited this, the net grew stricter—childhood and gray hair shared guilt in offense.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times the net has only tightened, until children and gray-haired alike were punished together for the same crime.

sentences.zh: 雖懲惡勸善，宜窮其制，而老幼流離，良亦可愍。

translations.literal: Though punishing evil and encouraging good should exhaust the system, yet old and young wandering apart is truly also pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: Though punishing evil and urging good must be carried through, the scattering of old and young is pitiable indeed.

sentences.zh: 自今逋讁之家及罪應質作，若年有老小，可停將送。

translations.literal: From now fugitive-exile households and crimes warranting collateral labor—if there are old and young in the years, sending may be halted.
translations.idiomatic: From this time forward, in cases of fugitive exile or crimes requiring collateral labor, if the household includes the aged or the very young, they need not be sent away.

sentences.zh: 」加左光祿大夫、行太子少傅沈約特進，鎮南將軍、江州刺史建安王偉儀同三司，司空、揚州刺史臨川王宏進位元爲太尉，驃騎將軍王茂爲司空，尚書令、雲麾將軍王瑩進號安左將軍，安北將軍、青冀二州刺史張稷進號鎮北將軍。

translations.literal: " Shen Yue, Left Grand Master for Splendor and acting Crown Prince Junior Tutor, was given Special Advance; Prince of Jian'an Wei, General Who Garrisons the South and Jiangzhou Inspector, received Third-Rank Ceremonial Parity; Prince of Linchuan Hong, Minister of Works and Yangzhou Inspector, was advanced to Grand Commander; Wang Mao, Fast Cavalry General, was made Minister of Works; Wang Ying, Masters of Writing Director and Cloud-Banner General, was promoted to Pacification Left General; Zhang Ji, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was promoted to General Who Garrisons the North.
translations.idiomatic: " Shen Yue, Left Grand Master for Splendor and acting Crown Prince Junior Tutor, received Special Advance; Prince of Jian'an Wei, General Who Garrisons the South and inspector of Jiangzhou, was granted third-rank ceremonial parity; Prince of Linchuan Hong, Minister of Works and inspector of Yangzhou, was advanced to Grand Commander; Wang Mao, Fast Cavalry General, became Minister of Works; Wang Ying, Masters of Writing Director and Cloud-Banner General, was promoted to Pacification Left General; and Zhang Ji, General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of Qing and Ji provinces, was promoted to General Who Garrisons the North.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，新昌、濟陽二郡野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuchen: in Xinchang and Jiyang commanderies wild silkworms formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen day, wild silkworms in Xinchang and Jiyang commanderies spun cocoons.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，曲赦揚、徐二州。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingsi: partial amnesty for Yang and Xu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingsi day, Yang and Xu provinces received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 築西靜壇於鐘山。

translations.literal: The Western Tranquility Altar was built on Mount Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Tranquility Altar was raised on Mount Zhong.

sentences.zh: 庚申，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 四月戊子，詔曰：「去歲朐山大殲丑類，宜爲京觀，用旌武功；

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuzi, an edict said: "Last year at Qushan we annihilated the enemy in great numbers; it would be fitting to build a victory mound to honor martial achievement;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuzi day, an edict declared: "Last year at Qushan we crushed the foe in vast numbers; a victory mound would befit such martial glory;

sentences.zh: 但伐罪弔民，皇王盛軌，掩骼埋胔，仁者用心。

translations.literal: Yet punishing crime and comforting the people is the great path of emperors and kings; covering bones and burying corpses is the way of the humane heart.
translations.idiomatic: Yet to punish the guilty and comfort the people is the royal way, and to cover bones and bury the dead is the work of a humane heart.

sentences.zh: 其下青州悉使收藏。

translations.literal: Order Qing province below to gather and bury them all.
translations.idiomatic: Let Qing province be ordered to gather and inter them all.

sentences.zh: 」百濟、扶南、林邑國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: " Baekje, Funan, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: " Baekje, Funan, and Linyi all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，以司空王茂領中權將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinsi: Minister of Works Wang Mao was made concurrent Central Army General.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinsi day, Wang Mao, Minister of Works, was also made Central Army General.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，宕昌國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: Dangchang sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinhai day, Dangchang sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，以安西將軍、荊州刺史安成王秀爲中衛將軍，護軍將軍鄱陽王恢爲平西將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei: General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Ancheng Xiu was made Central Guard General; Guard Army General Prince of Poyang Hui was made General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou, became Central Guard General; and Prince of Poyang Hui, Guard Army General, became General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛卯，輿駕親祠南郊，赦大辟以下。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, day xinmao: the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb; crimes below capital offense were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, on xinmao day of the first month of spring, the Emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person and pardoned all crimes short of capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，以兼尚書右僕射袁昂爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinyou: concurrent Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinyou day, Yuan Ang, who had been acting Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was confirmed in that office.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔曰：「掩骼埋胔，義重周經，槥櫝有加，事美漢策。

translations.literal: Day bingyin, an edict said: "Covering bones and burying corpses—righteousness weighs heavy in the Zhou classics; providing coffins and boxes—practice is praised in Han policy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, an edict said: "To cover bones and bury the dead weighs heavy in the Zhou classics; to supply coffins and shrouds was praised in Han policy.

sentences.zh: 朕向隅載懷，每勤造次，收藏之命，亟下哀矜；

translations.literal: I, turning to the corner in constant concern, have often hastened to act; orders for gathering and burying have been issued again and again in compassion;
translations.idiomatic: I have brooded in the corner of the hall and often moved in haste; again and again I have sent orders to gather and bury the dead in compassion;

sentences.zh: 而㝢縣遐深，遵奉未洽，髐然路隅，往往而有，言愍沉枯，彌勞傷惻。

translations.literal: Yet districts and counties are far and deep, compliance not yet thorough; skeletons by the roadsides are everywhere—speaking of pity for the sunken and withered, it ever more burdens the wounded heart.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the districts and counties lie far apart, and obedience is still incomplete; bare bones lie by the roads in every quarter, and pity for the sunken and withered only deepens the wound in my heart.

sentences.zh: 可明下遠近，各巡境界，若委骸不葬，或蒢衣莫改，卽就收斂，量給棺具。

translations.literal: Let this be made clear to near and far; each shall patrol their borders; if abandoned corpses lie unburied, or burial clothes unchanged, immediately gather and bury them, providing coffins according to need.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed near and far: each shall patrol his borders, and wherever corpses lie abandoned or shrouds unchanged, they shall at once be gathered and buried and coffins provided as needed.

sentences.zh: 庶夜哭之魂斯慰，沾霜之骨有歸。

translations.literal: Thus the souls that weep at night may be comforted, and frost-touched bones find their return.
translations.idiomatic: Then the souls that weep in the night may be eased, and bones touched by frost may find their rest.

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，新作太極殿，改爲十三間。

translations.literal: " Day xinsi: the Hall of Supreme Ultimate was newly built, changed to thirteen bays.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinsi day, the Hall of Supreme Ultimate was rebuilt with thirteen bays.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，以湘州刺史王珍國爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Third month, day guimao: Xiangzhou Inspector Wang Zhenguo was made Guard Army General.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao day, Wang Zhenguo, inspector of Xiangzhou, became Guard Army General.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙丑，特進、中軍將軍沈約卒。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yichou: Special Advance and Central Army General Shen Yue died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yichou day, Shen Yue, Special Advance and Central Army General, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，京邑大水。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: the capital region suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, the capital was struck by great flood.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guisi: the Imperial Temple was newly built, its foundation raised nine chi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guisi day, the Imperial Temple was rebuilt and its foundation raised nine chi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太極殿成。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Hall of Supreme Ultimate was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Hall of Supreme Ultimate was finished.

translations.literal: Ninth month of autumn, day wuwu: General Who Garrisons the South, open office third-rank ceremonial parity, Jiangzhou Inspector Prince of Jian'an Wei was made Pacification Army General, ceremonial parity as before;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on wuwu day, Prince of Jian'an Wei, General Who Garrisons the South with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity and inspector of Jiangzhou, became Pacification Army General, his ceremonial parity unchanged;

sentences.zh: 驃騎將軍、開府同三司之儀、揚州刺史臨川王宏爲司空；

translations.literal: Fast Cavalry General, open office equal-to-third-rank protocol, Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Linchuan Hong, Fast Cavalry General with open office equal-to-third-rank protocol and inspector of Yangzhou, became Minister of Works;

sentences.zh: 領中權將軍王茂爲驃騎將軍、開府同三司之儀、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Concurrent Central Army General Wang Mao was made Fast Cavalry General, open office equal-to-third-rank protocol, Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: and Wang Mao, who also held the Central Army Generalship, became Fast Cavalry General with open office equal-to-third-rank protocol and inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，詔曰：「明堂地勢卑濕，未稱乃心。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day dinghai, an edict said: "The Bright Hall's terrain is low and damp, not matching the heart's intent.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dinghai day, an edict said: "The Bright Hall stands on ground too low and damp to satisfy our intent.

sentences.zh: 外可量就埤起，以盡誠敬。」

translations.literal: Outside, one may measure and build upon the terrace to express full sincerity and reverence."
translations.idiomatic: Let a terrace be measured and raised there outside, so that sincerity and reverence may be fully shown."

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月壬戌，以丹陽尹晉安王綱爲荊州刺史。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, spring, first month, day renxu: Danyang Prefect Prince of Jin'an Gang was made Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, on renxu day of the first month of spring, Prince of Jin'an Gang, prefect of Danyang, became inspector of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以平西將軍、荊州刺史鄱陽王恢爲鎮西將軍、益州刺史。

translations.literal: Day guihai: General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Poyang Hui was made General Who Garrisons the West and Yizhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Prince of Poyang Hui, General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Jingzhou, became General Who Garrisons the West and inspector of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以翊右將軍安成王秀爲安西將軍、郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Aide Right General Prince of Ancheng Xiu was made General Who Pacifies the West and Yingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, Aide Right General, became General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，輿駕親耕籍田，赦天下，孝悌力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field; all under Heaven was pardoned; filial and incorrupt and diligent farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dinghai day, the Emperor plowed the sacred field in person, pardoned the realm, and granted one rank of nobility to the filial, the incorrupt, and the diligent farmers.

sentences.zh: 老人星見。

translations.literal: The Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: The Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，以新除中撫將軍、開府儀同三司建安王偉爲左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinhai: newly appointed Pacification Central General, open office third-rank ceremonial parity Prince of Jian'an Wei was made Left Grand Master for Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinhai day, Prince of Jian'an Wei, newly made Pacification Central General with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, became Left Grand Master for Splendor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，林邑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day xinmao: Linyi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinmao day, Linyi sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以郢州刺史豫章王綜爲安右將軍。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Yingzhou Inspector Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made Pacification Right General.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Prince of Yuzhang Zong, inspector of Yingzhou, became Pacification Right General.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，以通直散騎常侍韋叡爲中護軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinhai: Regular Attendant of Direct Transmission and Regular Palatial Cavalier Wei Rui was made Central Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinhai day, Wei Rui, Regular Attendant of Direct Transmission and Regular Palatial Cavalier, became Central Guard General.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，以南兗州刺史蕭景爲領軍將軍，領軍將軍柳慶遠爲安北將軍、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jihai: South Yanzhou Inspector Xiao Jing was made Commandant of the Army; Commandant of the Army Liu Qingyuan was made General Who Pacifies the North and Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jihai day, Xiao Jing, inspector of South Yanzhou, became Commandant of the Army; and Liu Qingyuan, Commandant of the Army, became General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，立皇子綸爲邵陵郡王，繹爲湘東郡王，紀爲武陵郡王。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day yihai: imperial sons Lun, Yi, and Ji were established as Prince of Shaoling commandery, Prince of Xiangdong commandery, and Prince of Wuling commandery respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai day, the imperial sons Lun, Yi, and Ji were enfeoffed as Prince of Shaoling, Prince of Xiangdong, and Prince of Wuling respectively.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，扶南、于闐國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao: Funan and Khotan each sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guimao day, Funan and Khotan each sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲作浮山堰。

translations.literal: That year the Fushan Dam was built.
translations.idiomatic: That year work began on the Fushan Dam.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月乙巳朔，皇太子冠，赦天下，賜爲父後者爵一級，王公以下班賚各有差，停遠近上慶禮。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, day yisi new moon: the Crown Prince was capped; all under Heaven was pardoned; those who succeeded their fathers were granted one rank of nobility; gifts were distributed to princes and officials each according to rank; congratulatory rites near and far were halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on the yisi new moon of the first month of spring, the Crown Prince received his cap; the realm was pardoned; heirs who succeeded their fathers received one rank of nobility; princes and officials received graded gifts; and congratulatory rites from near and far were suspended.

sentences.zh: 丙午，安左將軍、尚書令王瑩進號中權將軍。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Pacification Left General and Masters of Writing Director Wang Ying was promoted in title to Central Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Wang Ying, Pacification Left General and Director of the Masters of Writing, was advanced in title to Central Army General.

sentences.zh: 以鎮西將軍始興王憺爲中撫將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Garrisons the West Prince of Shixing Dan was made Pacification Central General.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Shixing Dan, General Who Garrisons the West, became Pacification Central General.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，輿駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕恭祗明祀，昭事上靈，臨竹宮而登泰壇，服裘冕而奉蒼璧，柴望旣升，誠敬克展，思所以對越乾元，弘宣德教；

translations.literal: An edict said: "I reverently perform bright sacrifice, clearly serve the exalted spirits, approach the bamboo palace and ascend the great altar, wear fur robes and cap and present the green jade disk; the fire sacrifice and mountain-prostration rites having been performed, sincerity and reverence fully displayed—we think how to respond to august Heaven, broadly spread virtue and teaching;
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "I reverently perform the bright rites and clearly serve the exalted spirits, enter the bamboo palace and ascend the great altar, wear fur robe and cap and offer the green jade disk; with the fire sacrifice and mountain-prostration complete and sincerity fully shown, I consider how to answer august Heaven and spread virtue and teaching abroad;

sentences.zh: 而缺于治道，政法多昧，實佇羣才，用康庶績。

translations.literal: Yet we fall short in governance, laws and policies are often obscure—truly we depend on the assembled talents to bring peace to the myriad tasks.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I fall short in the way of rule, and laws and policies remain obscure; I truly depend on the assembled talents to bring peace to the myriad tasks.

sentences.zh: 可班下遠近，博采英異。

translations.literal: Let this be proclaimed near and far, broadly gather outstanding and unusual men.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed near and far, and outstanding and unusual men be broadly gathered in.

sentences.zh: 若有確然鄉黨，獨行州閭，肥遁丘園，不求聞達，藏器待時，未加收采；

translations.literal: If there are those clearly known in village and district, walking alone in state and neighborhood, retiring plump to hills and gardens, not seeking fame, storing talent awaiting the time—not yet recruited;
translations.idiomatic: If there are men clearly known in village and district, upright in state and neighborhood, who retire in fullness to hills and gardens, seek no fame, and store their talent awaiting the time, yet have not been recruited;

sentences.zh: 或賢良、方正，孝悌、力田，並卽騰奏，具以名上。

translations.literal: Or those of worthy and good character, upright conduct, filial piety, or diligent farming—all should immediately report upward, listing names in full.
translations.idiomatic: Or men of worthy and good character, upright conduct, filial piety, or diligent farming—all should at once be reported upward with full names.

sentences.zh: 當擢彼周行，試以邦邑，庶百司咸事，兆民無隱。

translations.literal: They shall be elevated to the court ranks, tested in state and city, so that all offices have their tasks and the myriad people have nothing hidden.
translations.idiomatic: They shall be raised into court service and tested in state and city, so that every office has its task and nothing among the myriad people remains hidden.

sentences.zh: 又世輕世重，隨時約法，前以劓墨，用代重辟，猶念改悔，其路已壅，並可省除。

translations.literal: Moreover, penalties light and heavy through the ages, laws adjusted to the times—previously nose-cutting and tattooing were used in place of capital punishment; still mindful that repentance could occur, their path was already blocked—all may be eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, punishments have been light or heavy through the ages as law was adjusted to the times; nose-cutting and tattooing were once used in place of capital punishment, yet even repentance could no longer reach those so marked—all such penalties may now be abolished.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，汝陰王劉胤薨。

translations.literal: " Day bingyin: Prince of Ruyin Liu Yin died.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingyin day, Liu Yin, Prince of Ruyin, died.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengyin: Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengyin day, Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，老人星見。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Old Man Star was seen.
