translations.literal: Day xinchou: Central Guard General Wei Rui was made General Who Pacifies the North and Yongzhou Inspector; newly appointed Pacification Central General Prince of Shixing Dan was made Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Wei Rui, Central Guard General, became General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of Yongzhou; and Prince of Shixing Dan, newly made Pacification Central General, became inspector of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，驃騎將軍、開府同三司之儀、江州刺史王茂薨。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day dingchou: Fast Cavalry General, open office equal-to-third-rank protocol, Jiangzhou Inspector Wang Mao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou day, Wang Mao, Fast Cavalry General with open office equal-to-third-rank protocol and inspector of Jiangzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，以荊州刺史晉安王綱爲江州刺史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Jin'an Gang was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingsi day, Prince of Jin'an Gang, inspector of Jingzhou, became inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙未，老人星見。

translations.literal: Eighth month of autumn, day yiwei: the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on yiwei day, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，以長沙王深業爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai: Prince of Changsha Shen Ye was made Guard Army General.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guihai day, Prince of Changsha Shen Ye became Guard Army General.

sentences.zh: 狼牙修國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Langyaxiu sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Langyaxiu sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月己巳，詔曰：「觀時設教，王政所先，兼而利之，實惟務本，移風致治，咸由此作。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, day jisi, an edict said: "Observing the times to establish teaching is what royal government puts first; combining and benefiting—truly the root task; shifting customs to achieve order—all proceeds from this.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, on jisi day of the first month of spring, an edict said: "To read the times and set teaching is what royal government must put first; to combine and benefit the people is truly the root task; to shift the customs and bring order—all proceeds from this.

sentences.zh: 頃因革之令，隨事必下，而張弛之要，未臻厥宜，民瘼猶繁，廉平尚寡，所以佇旒纊而載懷，朝玉帛而興歎。

translations.literal: Recently reform orders have been issued with every matter, yet the essence of tightening and loosening has not reached proper balance; people's sufferings remain numerous, upright and fair officials still few—therefore we pause before the throne with constant concern, and at court facing tribute rise in sigh.
translations.idiomatic: Recently orders of reform have followed one upon another, yet the art of tightening and loosening has not reached its proper measure; the people's afflictions remain many and upright, fair officials are still few—therefore I pause before the throne in constant concern and sigh as I face tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 可申下四方，政有不便於民者，所在具條以聞。

translations.literal: Let this be declared to the four directions: where policies inconvenience the people, list them in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be declared to the four directions: wherever policy burdens the people, let the particulars be listed and reported.

sentences.zh: 守宰若清潔可稱，或侵漁爲蠹，分別奏上，將行黜陟。

translations.literal: Prefects and magistrates—if clean and admirable, or if exploiting and plundering like pests—report separately, and promotions and dismissals will follow.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects and magistrates, whether clean and worthy of praise or plundering like pests, shall be reported separately, and promotion or dismissal will follow.

sentences.zh: 長吏勸課，躬履堤防，勿有不脩，致妨農事。

translations.literal: Senior officials should encourage agriculture, personally inspect embankments and dikes—let there be no neglect that harms farming.
translations.idiomatic: Senior officials should encourage the fields and personally inspect embankments and dikes, so that no neglect harms the farming season.

sentences.zh: 關市之賦，或有未允，外時參量，優減舊格。」

translations.literal: Market and pass taxes may not be fair—periodically assess and reduce from the old scale."
translations.idiomatic: Market and pass taxes may not be fair—let them be reviewed from time to time and eased below the old scale."

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wuchen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，以安右將軍豫章王綜兼護軍。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day dingwei: Pacification Right General Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made concurrent Guard Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei day, Prince of Yuzhang Zong, Pacification Right General, was also made Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，以司空、揚州刺史臨川王宏爲中書監，驃騎大將軍、刺史如故。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiwei: Minister of Works, Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; Fast Cavalry Grand General and inspector as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiwei day, Prince of Linchuan Hong, Minister of Works and inspector of Yangzhou, became Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; his titles as Fast Cavalry Grand General and inspector remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，改作小廟畢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen: rebuilding of the small temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingshen day, rebuilding of the small temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以尚書令王瑩爲左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，尚書右僕射袁昂爲尚書左僕射，吏部尚書王暕爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Masters of Writing Director Wang Ying was made Left Grand Master for Splendor, open office third-rank ceremonial parity; Right Vice Director Yuan Ang was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Director of the Ministry of Personnel Wang Yan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Wang Ying, Director of the Masters of Writing, became Left Grand Master for Splendor with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity; Yuan Ang, Right Vice Director, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; and Wang Yan, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, became Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，老人星見。

translations.literal: Eighth month of autumn: the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 芮芮、河南遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Rouran and Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Rouran and Henan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王瑩薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: Left Grand Master for Splendor, open office third-rank ceremonial parity Wang Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi day, Wang Ying, Left Grand Master for Splendor with open office and third-rank ceremonial parity, died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day renchen: all under Heaven was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，以丹陽尹長沙王深業爲湘州刺史。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day wuwu: Danyang Prefect Prince of Changsha Shen Ye was made Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu day, Prince of Changsha Shen Ye, prefect of Danyang, became inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，以兼護軍豫章王綜爲安前將軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao: concurrent Guard Army Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made Pacification Front General.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao day, Prince of Yuzhang Zong, who also held the Guard Army post, became Pacification Front General.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史李畟斬交州反者阮宗孝，傳首京師。

translations.literal: Jiaozhou Inspector Li Bi executed Jiaozhou rebel Ruan Zongxiao and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bi, inspector of Jiaozhou, executed the rebel Ruan Zongxiao and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 曲赦交州。

translations.literal: Partial amnesty for Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhou received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以雍州刺史韋叡爲護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Yongzhou Inspector Wei Rui was made Guard Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Wei Rui, inspector of Yongzhou, became Guard Army General.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月辛未，輿駕親祠南郊，詔曰：「朕當扆思治，政道未明，昧旦劬勞，亟移星紀。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, spring, first month, day xinwei: the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb; an edict said: "I sit at the throne pondering governance; the way of government is not yet clear; from early dawn I toil, and the seasons have quickly passed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, on xinwei day of the first month of spring, the Emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person; an edict said: "I sit at the throne and ponder how to govern, yet the way of rule is not yet clear; from earliest dawn I toil, and the seasons have already turned again.

sentences.zh: 今太皞御氣，句芒首節，升中就陽，禋敬克展，務承天休，布茲和澤。

translations.literal: Now Grand Brightness governs the qi, Goumang opens the season; ascending to the center to meet the yang, sacrificial reverence fully displayed—we strive to receive Heaven's blessing and spread this harmonious grace.
translations.idiomatic: Now Grand Brightness governs the qi and Goumang opens the season; ascending to the center to meet the yang, sacrificial reverence is fully shown; I strive to receive Heaven's blessing and spread this harmonious grace.

sentences.zh: 尤貧之家，勿收今年三調。

translations.literal: Extremely poor households—do not collect this year's three levies.
translations.idiomatic: For the poorest households, do not collect this year's three levies.

sentences.zh: 其無田業者，所在量宜賦給。

translations.literal: Those without land and livelihood—in each place assess and provide according to need.
translations.idiomatic: For those without land or livelihood, let each place assess their need and provide accordingly.

sentences.zh: 若民有產子，卽依格優蠲。

translations.literal: If the people have births, immediately according to regulation grant lenient exemption.
translations.idiomatic: If the people have newborn children, grant lenient exemption according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 孤老鰥寡不能自存，咸加賑卹。

translations.literal: Orphans, elderly, widowers, and widows unable to support themselves—all receive relief and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: Orphans, the aged, widowers, and widows who cannot support themselves shall all receive relief and comfort.

sentences.zh: 班下四方。

translations.literal: Proclaim to the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed to the four directions.

sentences.zh: 諸州郡縣，時理獄訟，勿使冤滯，並若親覽。」

translations.literal: All provinces, commanderies, and counties—handle lawsuits in timely fashion, do not allow wrongful delay, as if personally reviewing."
translations.idiomatic: In every province, commandery, and county, let lawsuits be handled in timely fashion and wrongful delay be avoided, as if I were reviewing them in person."

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，老人星見，甲寅，以安前將軍豫章王綜爲南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengxu: the Old Man Star appeared; day jiayin: Pacification Front General Prince of Yuzhang Zong was made South Xuzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengxu day the Old Man Star was seen; on jiayin day, Prince of Yuzhang Zong, Pacification Front General, became inspector of South Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi: the Prince of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi day, the Prince of Henan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，初去宗廟牲。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day jiazi: sacrificial animals were first removed from the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiazi day, sacrificial animals were first removed from the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 潮溝獲白雀一。

translations.literal: One white sparrow was caught in Chaogou.
translations.idiomatic: A white sparrow was caught at Chaogou.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，以廬陵王績爲江州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wushen: Prince of Luling Ji was made Jiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wushen day, Prince of Luling Ji became inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月丁丑，以郢州刺史安成王秀爲鎮北將軍、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingchou: Yingzhou Inspector Prince of Ancheng Xiu was made General Who Garrisons the North and Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingchou day, Prince of Ancheng Xiu, inspector of Yingzhou, became General Who Garrisons the North and inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，老人星見。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou: the Old Man Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinchou day, the Old Man Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 扶南、婆利國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Funan and Poli each sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Funan and Poli each sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，去宗廟薦脩，始用蔬果。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter: cured meat offerings were removed from the ancestral temple; vegetables and fruits were first used.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, cured meat offerings were removed from the ancestral temple and vegetables and fruits were used for the first time.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月丁巳朔，詔曰：「夫樂所自生，含識之常性；

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, spring, first month, day dingsi new moon, an edict said: "Music's origin lies in life—this is the constant nature of all sentient beings;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on the dingsi new moon of the first month of spring, an edict declared: "The source of joy is life itself—this is the constant nature of every sentient being;

sentences.zh: 厚下安宅，馭世之通規。

translations.literal: Benevolent treatment of the lowly and secure settlement in one's home are the universal rules of governing the age.
translations.idiomatic: To treat those below with kindness and give every house a secure home is the universal law of ruling the realm.

sentences.zh: 朕矜此庶氓，無忘待旦，亟弘生聚之略，每布寬恤之恩；

translations.literal: I pity these common multitudes, never forgetting to await the dawn, eagerly extending policies of nurturing and gathering, frequently dispensing merciful relief—
translations.idiomatic: I pity the common people, rise before dawn without forgetting them, and have again and again opened policies to nurture and gather them, often dispensing lenient mercy—

sentences.zh: 而編戶未滋，遷徙尚有，輕去故鄉，豈其本志？

translations.literal: yet registered households have not increased, migration still exists, lightly leaving the native place—is that their true intent?
translations.idiomatic: yet registered households have not multiplied, migration continues, and people lightly abandon their native places—is that truly what they wish?

sentences.zh: 資業殆闕，自返莫由，巢南之心，亦何能弭。

translations.literal: Resources and livelihood are nearly exhausted, with no means to return on their own; the heart that nests to the south—how can it be stilled?
translations.idiomatic: Their means and livelihood are nearly gone, they cannot make their own way back, and the heart that turns homeward—how can it find rest?

sentences.zh: 今開元發歲，品物惟新，思俾黔黎，各安舊所。

translations.literal: Now the new year opens, all things are renewed; I wish to make the black-haired people each secure in their old abodes.
translations.idiomatic: Now a new year opens and all things are made new; I mean to let the black-haired people each settle again in their old homes.

sentences.zh: 將使郡無曠土，邑靡遊民，雞犬相聞，桑柘交畛。

translations.literal: This will cause commanderies to have no idle land, districts no wandering people—cocks and dogs within hearing, mulberry and paper-mulberry fields meeting at boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Then no commandery need keep idle fields, no district harbor wandering folk—neighbors' cocks and dogs will be heard, mulberry and paper-mulberry lines will meet along the lanes.

sentences.zh: 凡天下之民，有流移他境，在天監十七年正月一日以前，可開恩半歲，悉聽還本，蠲課三年。

translations.literal: All people under Heaven who have drifted to other regions, before the first day of the first month of Tianjian 17, may receive grace for half a year—permit them all to return home, exempting taxes for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Every subject who has drifted elsewhere, if the move came before the first day of the first month of Tianjian 17, shall receive a half-year grace period, be allowed to return home, and have taxes remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 其流寓過遠者，量加程日。

translations.literal: For those who have sojourned very far, add days to the journey time as measured.
translations.idiomatic: For those who have settled far away, extra days shall be added to the allowed travel time.

sentences.zh: 若有不樂還者，卽使著土籍爲民，准舊課輸。

translations.literal: If there are those unwilling to return, immediately have them register on local rolls as residents, paying taxes according to former rates.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever is unwilling to return shall at once be entered on local rolls as a resident and taxed at the old rates.

sentences.zh: 若流移之後，本鄉無復居宅者，村司三老及餘親屬，卽爲詣縣，占請村內官地官宅，令相容受，使戀本者還有所託。

translations.literal: If after migration there is no dwelling left in the native village, village officers, three elders, and other kin shall go to the county and petition for official lands and dwellings within the village, that they may be received and accommodated—giving those who yearn for home a place to return to.
translations.idiomatic: If a migrant's home village no longer holds a dwelling, village officers, three elders, and kin shall go to the county and claim official land and dwellings in the village so they can be received—giving those who long for home somewhere to return.

sentences.zh: 凡坐爲市埭諸職，割盜衰滅應被封籍者，其田宅車牛，是民生之具，不得悉以沒入，皆優量分留，使得自止。

translations.literal: All those convicted for market toll posts and similar offices, robbery, diminishing inheritance, or offenses warranting seizure of property—for their fields, dwellings, carts, and oxen are the tools of livelihood; they may not all be forfeited; in each case a measured portion shall be left so they can support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In cases of market-toll offices, robbery, or diminishing inheritance where property should be seized, fields, dwellings, carts, and oxen—the very tools of life—may not all be confiscated; a generous portion shall be left in every case so people can support themselves.

sentences.zh: 其商賈富室，亦不得頓相兼併。

translations.literal: Wealthy merchant households likewise may not suddenly encroach upon and merge properties.
translations.idiomatic: Wealthy merchant houses likewise may not suddenly swallow one another up.

sentences.zh: 遁叛之身，罪無輕重，並許首出，還復民伍。

translations.literal: Those who fled and rebelled, regardless of the gravity of the offense, all may surrender and be restored to the common rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Whether the crime was great or small, fugitives and deserters may all surrender and be restored to the common rolls.

sentences.zh: 若有拘限，自還本役。

translations.literal: If there are constraints on them, they shall return to their original corvée duty.
translations.idiomatic: Where there are fixed obligations, they shall return to their original service.

sentences.zh: 並爲條格，咸使知聞。」

translations.literal: All these are established as regulations and made known throughout."
translations.idiomatic: Let these rules be set out and made known everywhere."

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，鎮北將軍、雍州刺史安成王秀薨。

translations.literal: Second month, day guisi: General Who Pacifies the North and Yongzhou Inspector Prince of Ancheng Xiu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guisi day, General Who Pacifies the North and Yongzhou inspector Prince of Ancheng Xiu died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: a great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以領石頭戍事南康王績爲南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Prince of Nankang Ji, who commanded Stone Fort garrison, was made South Yanzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Prince of Nankang Ji, who held command of Stone Fort garrison, was made inspector of South Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，老人星見。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen: the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiashen day, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 丙申，改封建安王偉爲南平王。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Prince of Jian'an Wei was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Prince of Jian'an Wei was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊寅，驃騎大將軍、揚州刺史臨川王宏免。

translations.literal: Fifth month of summer, day wuyin: Rapid Cavalry Grand General and Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wuyin day, Rapid Cavalry Grand General and Yangzhou inspector Prince of Linchuan Hong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己卯、干陁利國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Gandhara sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Gandhara sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 以領軍將軍蕭景爲安右將軍，監揚州。

translations.literal: Commandant-of-the-Guards General Xiao Jing was made Pacification Right General and overseer of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Jing, Commandant-of-the-Guards, was made Pacification Right General and overseer of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以臨川王宏爲中軍將軍、中書監。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Central Army General and Supervisor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Central Army General and Supervisor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，以益州刺史鄱陽王恢爲領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou: Prince of Poyang Hui, Yizhou Inspector, was made Commandant-of-the-Guards General.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou day, Prince of Poyang Hui, inspector of Yizhou, was made Commandant-of-the-Guards.

sentences.zh: 中軍將軍，中書監臨川王宏以本號行司徒。

translations.literal: Central Army General and Supervisor of the Secretariat Prince of Linchuan Hong acted as Minister of Education under his existing titles.
translations.idiomatic: Central Army General and Supervisor of the Secretariat Prince of Linchuan Hong served as acting Minister of Education under his existing titles.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以國子祭酒蔡撙爲吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Imperial Academy Rector Cai Zuan was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Cai Zuan, Imperial Academy Rector, was made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬寅，老人星見。

translations.literal: Eighth month of autumn, day renyin: the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on renyin day, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 詔以兵騶奴婢，男年登六十，女年登五十，免爲平民。

translations.literal: An edict said: military escort slaves and servant-women, men reaching sixty and women reaching fifty, shall be freed as common people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that military escort slaves and servant-women—men at sixty and women at fifty—should be freed as commoners.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，以中軍將軍、行司徒臨川王宏爲中書監、司徒。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day yihai: Central Army General and acting Minister of Education Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Supervisor of the Secretariat and Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai day, Central Army General and acting Minister of Education Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Supervisor of the Secretariat and Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，以南平王偉爲左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinhai: Prince of Nanping Wei was made Left Grandee for Splendid Merit with open office at third-rank ceremonial parity.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, Prince of Nanping Wei was made Left Grandee for Splendid Merit with an open office at third-rank ceremonial parity.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月甲申，以領軍將軍鄱陽王恢爲征西將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史，荊州刺史始興王憺爲中撫將軍、開府儀同三司、領軍。

translations.literal: In spring of the eighteenth year, first month, day jiashen: Commandant-of-the-Guards General Prince of Poyang Hui was made General Who Pacifies the West with open office at third-rank ceremonial parity and Jingzhou Inspector; Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Dan was made Central Pacification General with open office at third-rank ceremonial parity and Commandant-of-the-Guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on jiashen day of the first month of spring, Commandant-of-the-Guards Prince of Poyang Hui was made General Who Pacifies the West with an open office at third-rank ceremonial parity and inspector of Jingzhou; and Jingzhou inspector Prince of Shixing Dan was made Central Pacification General with an open office at third-rank ceremonial parity and Commandant-of-the-Guards.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左僕射袁昂爲尚書令，尚書右僕射王暕爲尚書左僕射，太子詹事徐勉爲尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Ang was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Right Vice Director Wang Jian was made Left Vice Director; Crown Prince Steward Xu Mian was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Ang, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, became Director of the Masters of Writing; Wang Jian, Right Vice Director, became Left Vice Director; and Xu Mian, Crown Prince Steward, became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，輿駕親祠南郊，孝悌力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb; filial sons, obedient brothers, and strong farmers received one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person, and filial sons, obedient brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，老人星見。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuwu: the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuwu day, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 四月丁巳，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day dingsi: a great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dingsi day, a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，老人星見。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiashen: the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiashen day, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 于闐、扶南國各遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Khotan and Funan each sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan and Funan each sent envoys bearing tribute.

translations.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
